lemmas.def_zh: 新水手, 不习惯航海的人
lemmas.def_en: a person who lives and works on land

examples.en: The seasoned sailors teased the dizzy landlubber who felt seasick on calm waters.
examples.zh: 经验丰富的水手们嘲弄那个在平静海面上就晕船的新手。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 landlubber 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the discharge of urine

examples.en: The doctor asked the patient if he felt any burning pain during micturition.
examples.zh: 医生询问患者在排尿时是否有灼痛感。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 micturition 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: kit consisting of a complete outfit (clothing and accessories) for a new baby

examples.en: Her grandparents bought a lovely cotton layette to welcome the newborn baby home.
examples.zh: 祖父母买了一套可爱的纯棉新生儿衣物，迎接小宝宝回家。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 layette 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 大摇大摆, 摆架子, 喧闹, 闹饮
lemmas.def_en: engage in boisterous, drunken merrymaking

examples.en: Groups of drunken revelers continued to roister through the streets until early dawn.
examples.zh: 成群喝醉的狂欢者在街头喧闹狂饮，一直闹到清晨。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 roister 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (botany) a covering that resembles scales or bran that covers some plant parts

examples.en: A medicated shampoo helped remove the stubborn scurf from his dry, irritated scalp.
examples.zh: 一款药用洗发水帮助去除了他干燥、发炎头皮上的顽固皮屑。

lemmas.def_zh: 满是头屑的, 皮屑的
lemmas.def_en: having or producing or covered with scurf

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scurf 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 做讼棍, 讲歪理, 欺诈, 挑剔, 诡辩
lemmas.def_en: argue over petty things

examples.en: The crooked lawyer loved to pettifog over minor technicalities to delay the trial.
examples.zh: 那个奸诈的律师喜欢在微不足道的细节上百般诡辩以拖延审判。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pettifog 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a large round wicker basket (used on farms)

examples.en: An old-fashioned straw skep sat peacefully beneath the blooming apple trees.
examples.zh: 一个老式的草编蜂箱静静地安放在盛开的苹果树下。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 skep 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a familiar name for a person (often a shortened version of a person's given name)

examples.en: Because of his swift movements, he earned the flattering soubriquet of The Falcon.
examples.zh: 由于动作迅捷，他赢得了“猎鹰”这一受人称赞的绰号。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 soubriquet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a herder of sheep (on an open range); someone who keeps the sheep together in a flock

examples.en: The solitary sheepherder guided his flock safely through the rugged mountain pass.
examples.zh: 孤独的牧羊人引导着他的羊群安全穿过险峻的山口。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sheepherder 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 破伤风的, 强直性的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or causing tetany

examples.en: The neurotoxin caused violent tetanic spasms that paralyzed the experimental animal completely.
examples.zh: 该神经毒素引发了强烈的强直性痉挛，使实验动物完全瘫痪。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tetanic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a small sharp-pointed tip resembling a spike on a stem or leaf

examples.en: Each grain spikelet on the wheat stem holds several developing reproductive florets.
examples.zh: 麦茎上的每个小穗都包含着数朵发育中的生殖小花。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 spikelet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: one of two thick muscles running from the sternum and clavicle to the mastoid and occipital bone; turns head obliquely to the opposite side; when acting together they flex the neck and extend the head

examples.en: She strained her sternocleidomastoid muscle after turning her head too quickly in tennis.
examples.zh: 她在打网球时转头过急，拉伤了胸锁乳突肌。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sternocleidomastoid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an automotive system for shifting gears in which the gears revolve at the same speed and so shift smoothly

examples.en: Modern manual cars rely on synchromesh gears to make shifting smoother without grinding.
examples.zh: 现代手动挡汽车依靠同步啮合齿轮使换挡更平顺且不打齿。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 synchromesh 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 塔帕〔太平洋某些岛上居民用来做衣服的构树皮〕(又叫 tappa cloth)
lemmas.def_en: the thin fibrous bark of the paper mulberry and Pipturus albidus

examples.en: The islanders displayed exquisite patterns painted on traditional tappa made from tree bark.
examples.zh: 岛民们展示了用树皮制成的传统塔帕布上绘制的精美图案。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tappa 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: thin trapezoidal bone of the skull forming the posterior and inferior parts of the nasal septum

examples.en: The surgeon carefully examined the fractured vomer to restore the patient's nasal septum.
examples.zh: 外科医生仔细检查了骨折的犁骨，以修复患者的鼻中隔。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vomer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a verse line having four metrical feet

examples.en: The poet wrote the entire ballad in lively iambic tetrameter to maintain rhythm.
examples.zh: 诗人用轻快的抑扬格四音步写下了整首民谣以保持节奏感。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tetrameter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 神力, 法术, 巫术, 妖术
lemmas.def_en: the effect of supernatural or divine intervention in human affairs

examples.en: Ancient mystics practiced theurgy in hopes of communicating directly with divine beings.
examples.zh: 古代神秘主义者修习通神术，希望能与神明直接沟通。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 theurgy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 杀人越货行为, 谋财害命
lemmas.def_en: murder and robbery by thugs

examples.en: Colonial authorities launched campaigns to eradicate thuggee along the dangerous trade routes.
examples.zh: 殖民当局发起了清除危险贸易路线上谋财害命行径的行动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 thuggee 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a small tasty bit of food

examples.en: He whispered an intriguing titbit of celebrity gossip during our morning coffee break.
examples.zh: 在早晨的咖啡休息时间，他悄悄透露了一条引人入胜的名人八卦逸闻。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 titbit 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: valuable timber tree of New Zealand yielding hard reddish wood used for furniture and bridges and wharves

examples.en: The Maori carved magnificent canoes from the durable timber of the native totara.
examples.zh: 毛利人利用本土托塔拉树坚固的木材雕刻出宏伟的独木舟。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 totara 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: on or relating to or characteristic of the region or peoples beyond the Alps from Italy (or north of the Alps)

examples.en: Ancient traders established transalpine routes to transport goods across the rugged mountains.
examples.zh: 古代商人开辟了跨阿尔卑斯山路线，穿过险峻的山脉运输货物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 transalpine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: wilt [植]黄萎病(轮枝菌所致的植物病)
lemmas.def_en: a fungus of the genus Verticillium

examples.en: The farmer noticed signs of verticillium wilt spreading rapidly through the cotton field.
examples.zh: 农夫注意到黄萎病迹象在棉花地里迅速蔓延。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 verticillium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any woodland plant of the genus Anemone grown for its beautiful flowers and whorls of dissected leaves

examples.en: Delicate white windflowers began to bloom across the forest floor in early spring.
examples.zh: 初春时节，娇嫩的白色白头翁花开始在林间空地上绽放。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 windflower 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (music) a notation written at the beginning or end of a passage that is to be repeated

examples.en: The conductor signaled the orchestra to return to the segno for the repeat.
examples.zh: 指挥示意管弦乐队返回记号处进行重复演奏。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 segno 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an area where merchandise (such as cars) can be displayed

examples.en: Bidders gathered in the crowded saleroom as the rare painting went under the hammer.
examples.zh: 当这幅珍贵的画作开始拍卖时，竞拍者聚集在拥挤的拍卖厅里。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 saleroom 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a hammer with a cleft at one end for pulling nails

examples.en: He grabbed a clawhammer from his toolbox to pull the rusted nails out.
examples.zh: 他从工具箱里拿出一把羊角锤，拔出了那些生锈的钉子。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 clawhammer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 贾第虫病, 梨形鞭毛虫病
lemmas.def_en: infection of the intestines with protozoa found in contaminated food and water; characterized by diarrhea and nausea and flatulence and abdominal discomfort

examples.en: Drinking untreated river water during the hike caused several campers to contract giardiasis.
examples.zh: 徒步旅行中饮用未经处理的河水导致几名露营者感染了贾第虫病。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 giardiasis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 麦片粥, 蛋奶甜点心, 假恭维
lemmas.def_en: a bland custard or pudding especially of oatmeal

examples.en: The critic dismissed the politician's speech as empty flummery meant to deceive voters.
examples.zh: 评论家驳斥了该政客的演讲，称其为意在欺骗选民的空洞奉承。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 flummery 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a French bean variety with light-colored seeds; usually dried

examples.en: A wandering musician played a sweet, melancholic tune on his wooden flageolet.
examples.zh: 一位流浪音乐家用他的木制六孔竖笛吹奏出优美而忧伤的曲调。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 flageolet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: thin projections forming a fringe (especially around the ovarian end of the Fallopian tube)

examples.en: The mature ovum is gently swept into the fallopian tube by the fimbria.
examples.zh: 成熟的卵子被输卵管伞轻柔地扫入输卵管中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fimbria 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 意大利宽面条, 扁平细面条； （用意大利宽面条烹制的）白脱奶油面
lemmas.def_en: pasta in flat strips wider than linguine

examples.en: We ordered freshly made fettuccini tossed in a rich, creamy garlic parmesan sauce.
examples.zh: 我们点了拌有浓郁蒜香帕尔马奶酪奶油汁的新鲜意式宽面。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fettuccini 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a small squadron

examples.en: The decorated escadrille was assigned to patrol the border during the tense conflict.
examples.zh: 这支功勋卓著的飞行小队在紧张的冲突期间被派去巡逻边境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 escadrille 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: inflammation of the lining of the uterus (of the endometrium)

examples.en: The veterinarian treated the mare with antibiotics to cure her persistent uterine endometritis.
examples.zh: 兽医用抗生素给母马进行治疗，以治愈其持续的子宫内膜炎。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 endometritis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (尤指世袭的)君主, 开国君主
lemmas.def_en: a hereditary ruler

examples.en: The powerful dynast ruled the empire for nearly four decades until his sudden death.
examples.zh: 这位权势显赫的君主统治了该帝国近四十年，直至突然离世。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dynast 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: coarse edible red seaweed

examples.en: The chef sprinkled dried dulse over the seafood salad to enhance its savory flavor.
examples.zh: 厨师在海鲜沙拉上撒了干红皮藻，以增添其鲜美风味。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dulse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a clergyman; especially a settled minister or parson

examples.en: The village dominie gathered the children every Sunday to teach them basic reading skills.
examples.zh: 这位乡村牧师每周日都召集孩子们，教他们基本的阅读技能。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dominie 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: presence of multiple diverticula in the walls of the colon

examples.en: A high-fiber diet is often recommended to manage the symptoms of diverticulosis effectively.
examples.zh: 通常建议采用高纤维饮食来有效控制肠憩室病的症状。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 diverticulosis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 定纸框, 手工制纸的毛边
lemmas.def_en: rough edge left by a deckle on handmade paper or produced artificially on machine-made paper

examples.en: The artist prefers handmade paper with a natural deckle along all four edges.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家偏爱四周带有天然毛边的手工纸。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 deckle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or containing divalent copper

examples.en: The chemist used cuprous oxide to produce a vibrant red glaze on the ceramics.
examples.zh: 化学家使用氧化亚铜在陶瓷上烧制出鲜艳的红色釉面。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cuprous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a Malayan dagger with a wavy blade

examples.en: The warrior wore a traditional creese with a distinctive wavy blade at his belt.
examples.zh: 那名武士腰间佩带着一柄带有独特波浪形刀刃的传统短剑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 creese 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: subject to alteration or change

examples.en: Under the new policy, minor prison sentences are commutable to community service hours.
examples.zh: 根据新政策，较轻的监禁刑罚可转换为社区服务时间。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 commutable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (电影院/剧院/旅馆等处的)门卫, 穿制服的看门人, 门警
lemmas.def_en: a uniformed doorman

examples.en: The uniformed commissionaire stepped forward to open the heavy glass doors for hotel guests.
examples.zh: 身穿制服的门卫走上前去，为酒店客人推开沉重的玻璃门。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 commissionaire 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: pertaining to the tongue and throat

examples.en: Damage to the glossopharyngeal nerve can cause difficulty in swallowing and loss of taste.
examples.zh: 舌咽神经受损可能导致吞咽困难和味觉丧失。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 glossopharyngeal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [美国俚语]外国佬(尤指意大利、西班牙、葡萄牙、希腊等国血统的人)；狡诈的家伙；滑头小伙子；[兽医学](马用)药物油脂球
lemmas.def_en: (ethnic slur) offensive term for a person of Italian descent

examples.en: The film depicted corrupt officers using offensive slurs like greaseball against local immigrants.
examples.zh: 这部电影描绘了腐败警官对当地移民使用诸如外国佬等侮辱性字眼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 greaseball 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (British slang) boss

examples.en: I will need to ask the guvnor before taking next Friday off from work.
examples.zh: 下周五请假之前，我得先去问问老板。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 guvnor 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a writer of literary works

examples.en: The French litterateur spent his final years writing critical essays about romantic poetry.
examples.zh: 这位法国文人在晚年潜心撰写关于浪漫主义诗歌的评论散文。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 litterateur 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a salesman who travels to call on customers

examples.en: The roadman placed bright orange cones along the highway before beginning the asphalt repairs.
examples.zh: 修路工人在开始修补沥青之前，沿着公路摆放了鲜橙色的锥形标。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 roadman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any disease of domestic animals that resembles a plague

examples.en: A deadly murrain swept through the valley, wiping out nearly half of the cattle.
examples.zh: 一场致命的家畜瘟疫席卷了山谷，消灭了近一半的牛群。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 murrain 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: being six more than sixty

examples.en: Please turn to chapter LXVI of the ancient manuscript to read the full decree.
examples.zh: 请翻至古手稿的第六十六章以阅读完整的法令。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lxvi 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: being four more than sixty

examples.en: The tournament organizers seeded the top sixty-four players in the LXIV draw bracket.
examples.zh: 锦标赛组织者将前六十四名种子选手编排进了六十四强对阵表中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lxiv 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a low chest or table with drawers and supported on four legs

examples.en: She kept her precious antique jewelry inside the top drawer of the wooden lowboy.
examples.zh: 她把珍贵的古董首饰放在那件木质矮脚衣橱的顶层抽屉里。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lowboy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: Australian mound bird; incubates eggs naturally in sandy mounds

examples.en: The elusive lowan builds large mounds of leaf litter to incubate its eggs safely.
examples.zh: 行踪隐秘的眼斑冢雉会筑起巨大的落叶堆，以安全孵化鸟卵。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lowan 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: red-fruited bramble native from Oregon to Baja California

examples.en: Grandma made delicious homemade jam using freshly picked loganberries from the backyard garden.
examples.zh: 祖母用后院花园里新摘的罗苷莓制作了美味的自制果酱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 loganberry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: sarcoma of smooth muscle; occurs most often digestive tract or uterus or bladder or prostate

examples.en: The oncology team decided to treat the rare leiomyosarcoma with surgery and chemotherapy.
examples.zh: 肿瘤医疗团队决定通过手术和化疗来治疗这种罕见的平滑肌肉瘤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 leiomyosarcoma 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: long and slender with a very small internal diameter

examples.en: Under the microscope, tiny hairlike structures were visible on the surface of the cell.
examples.zh: 在显微镜下，细胞表面可见微小的毛发状结构。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hairlike 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: if nothing else (`leastwise' is informal and `leastways' is colloquial)

examples.en: He said he would attend the party, or leastways he promised he would try.
examples.zh: 他说他会参加聚会，至少他承诺过会尽力去。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 leastways 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a lazy person

examples.en: Get out of bed now, you lazybones, or you will miss the morning train.
examples.zh: 快点起床，你这个懒骨头，否则就要错过早班火车了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lazybones 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of various funnel-shaped parts of the body (but especially the hypophyseal stalk)

examples.en: The pituitary stalk passes directly through the infundibulum to connect with the brain.
examples.zh: 垂体柄直接穿过漏斗管，与大脑紧密相连。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 infundibulum 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [医]足后段：足的后部，包括距骨和跟骨区
lemmas.def_en: a rear foot of a quadruped

examples.en: Severe pain in the hindfoot can make it difficult for patients to walk comfortably.
examples.zh: 足后段的剧烈疼痛会使患者难以舒适地行走。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hindfoot 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: in this general vicinity

examples.en: There are several quiet cafes hereabout where you can read and relax peacefully.
examples.zh: 这附近有几家安静的咖啡馆，你可以在那里静心阅读和放松。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hereabout 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a surgical instrument that stops bleeding by clamping the blood vessel

examples.en: The surgeon quickly asked the scrub nurse for a curved hemostat to control the bleeding.
examples.zh: 外科医生迅速向器械护士要了一把弯止血钳来控制出血。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hemostat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 更年期, 绝经, 断经, 断经期, 危机, 转折点, 危机期
lemmas.def_en: a period in a man's life corresponding to menopause

examples.en: Many women experience emotional and physical changes during the climacteric phase of life.
examples.zh: 许多女性在人生的更年期阶段都会经历身心两方面的变化。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 climacteric 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 便宜货；新出品；小玩意儿
lemmas.def_en: something unspecified whose name is either forgotten or not known

examples.en: She bought a shiny metal doodad to hang on her keychain as decoration.
examples.zh: 她买了一个闪亮的金属小玩意儿挂在钥匙扣上当装饰。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 doodad 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (of plants) producing a well-developed stem above ground

examples.en: Botanists observed that the cauline leaves were distinctly smaller than the basal ones.
examples.zh: 植物学家观察到茎生叶明显小于基生叶。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cauline 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 前院, 天井, 柱廊
lemmas.def_en: a courtyard or portico in front of a building (especially a cathedral)

examples.en: Tourists gathered in the cathedral's open parvis to take photographs before entering.
examples.zh: 游客们在进入前聚集在大教堂开阔的前院里拍照。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 parvis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (ancient Greece) a hymn of praise (especially one sung in ancient Greece to invoke or thank a deity)

examples.en: The poet wrote a moving pean to celebrate the soldiers' hard-won victory.
examples.zh: 诗人写了一首感人的赞歌，庆祝士兵们来之不易的胜利。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pean 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a more or less level land surface representing an advanced stage of erosion undisturbed by crustal movements

examples.en: Millions of years of relentless erosion reduced the rugged mountain range to a vast peneplain.
examples.zh: 数百万年不间断的侵蚀将崎岖的山脉化为了一片广阔的准平原。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 peneplain 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 经学院；伊斯兰教学校帕萨特雷；小礼拜寺
lemmas.def_en: a Muslim school in Indonesia operated by religious leaders; produces young militants skilled in jihad

examples.en: He spent his formative years studying Islamic traditions at a traditional pesantren in Java.
examples.zh: 他在爪哇的一所传统伊斯兰经学院度过了学习伊斯兰传统的成长岁月。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pesantren 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a cathode that emits electrons when illuminated

examples.en: Photons striking the photocathode generate electrons that amplify the incoming light signal significantly.
examples.zh: 撞击光电阴极的光子会产生电子，从而显著放大传入的光信号。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 photocathode 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 轰鸣的, 凄切的, 哀鸣的
lemmas.def_en: loud and resounding

examples.en: The plangent cry of the distant loon echoed across the foggy lake at dawn.
examples.zh: 黎明时分，远方潜鸟凄切的哀鸣在雾气弥漫的湖面上回荡。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 plangent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: perennial of the genus Phytolacca

examples.en: Native Americans historically used the dark purple berries of pokeweed as a natural dye.
examples.zh: 历史上，美洲原住民曾使用美洲商陆深紫色的浆果作为天然染料。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pokeweed 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 小猫, 双刃刀, 肠线
lemmas.def_en: a long double-edged knife used for amputations

examples.en: Historical medical kits often contained a double-edged catling specifically designed for swift amputations.
examples.zh: 历史上的医疗箱中通常装有一把专为快速截肢设计的双刃刀。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 catling 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: prescribed guide for conduct or action

examples.en: Employees were expected to follow every corporate prescript without questioning management decisions.
examples.zh: 员工被要求遵守每一项公司规定，不得质疑管理层的决定。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 prescript 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a prophetic vision (as in a dream)

examples.en: Her remarkable prevision allowed the company to pivot successfully before the market crashed.
examples.zh: 她非凡的先见之明使公司在市场崩盘前成功转型。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 prevision 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: free-living or colonial organisms with diverse nutritional and reproductive modes

examples.en: Under the microscope, the single-celled protist moved rapidly through the drop of pond water.
examples.zh: 在显微镜下，这个单细胞原生生物在一滴池塘水中迅速移动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 protist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or exhibiting pyroelectricity

examples.en: Motion detectors often utilize pyroelectric sensors to register sudden changes in surrounding temperature.
examples.zh: 运动探测器通常利用热电传感器来记录周围温度的突然变化。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pyroelectric 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an abnormal but benign thickening of the prickle-cell layer of the skin (as in psoriasis)

examples.en: The dermatologist diagnosed the darkened patches of thickened skin as a mild form of acanthosis.
examples.zh: 皮肤科医生将变厚变深的斑块诊断为轻度棘皮症。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 acanthosis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 分成四组的, 由四部分组成的
lemmas.def_en: involving four parties

examples.en: The quadripartite agreement was signed by representatives from all four European neighboring nations.
examples.zh: 这项四方协议由所有四个欧洲邻国的代表共同签署。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 quadripartite 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (使)再转变, (使)恢复信仰, (使)恢复故态
lemmas.def_en: convert back

examples.en: The developer plans to reconvert the old industrial warehouse back into modern residential lofts.
examples.zh: 开发商计划将旧工业仓库重新改建为现代住宅阁楼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 reconvert 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 被累加, 有助于, 报偿
lemmas.def_en: return or recoil

examples.en: Her tireless dedication to charity work will ultimately redound to the firm's good reputation.
examples.zh: 她对慈善工作孜孜不倦的奉献最终将有助于提升公司的声誉。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 redound 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 重新攀登, 重新调节
lemmas.def_en: establish on a new scale

examples.en: The graphic designer had to rescale the vector image to fit the larger billboard.
examples.zh: 平面设计师不得不重新调整矢量图的尺寸以适应更大的广告牌。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rescale 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 残留物, 剩余物, 残数, 余数, 留数, 社会渣滓
lemmas.def_en: something left after other parts have been taken away

examples.en: After the solvent evaporated, a sticky dark residuum remained at the bottom of the flask.
examples.zh: 溶剂蒸发后，烧瓶底部残留下一层粘稠的深色残余物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 residuum 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a medicated lozenge used to soothe the throat

examples.en: Sucking on a menthol pastille quickly soothed his irritated throat.
examples.zh: 含服一颗薄荷润喉糖迅速缓解了他发炎的喉咙。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pastille 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: be later in time

examples.en: She asked me to postdate the cheque until next Friday.
examples.zh: 她让我把支票的日期延后写到下周五。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 postdate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 一种细薄的棉织品
lemmas.def_en: a sheer stiff muslin

examples.en: The bride wore a delicate white gown made of crisp organdy.
examples.zh: 新娘穿着一件由挺括白蝉翼纱制成的精致礼服。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 organdy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 管理床铺的人, 供观赏的植物
lemmas.def_en: an ornamental plant suitable for planting in a flowerbed

examples.en: Bright red geraniums are widely chosen as summer bedders in parks.
examples.zh: 鲜红的天竺葵常被选作公园里的夏季花坛观赏植物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bedder 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a decorated bier on which a coffin rests in state during a funeral

examples.en: The president's coffin rested on a black catafalque inside the rotunda.
examples.zh: 总统的灵柩停放在圆形大厅内的黑色灵柩台上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 catafalque 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: luminous intensity measured in candelas

examples.en: The old lighthouse beam emitted over one million candlepower across the sea.
examples.zh: 那座古老灯塔的光束向海面射出超过一百万烛光的亮度。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 candlepower 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 早熟的少女；放荡的少妇；仙女般的少女
lemmas.def_en: a sexually attractive young woman

examples.en: The controversial novel revolves around a middle-aged man infatuated with a nymphet.
examples.zh: 这部充满争议的小说围绕着一个迷恋早熟少女的中年男子展开。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nymphet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: tropical shrub having clusters of white or violet or yellow flowers

examples.en: Colorful butterflies gathered in swarms around the fragrant purple buddleia bush.
examples.zh: 五彩缤纷的蝴蝶成群聚集在芬芳的紫色醉鱼草丛周围。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 buddleia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 穿长裤的; 穿马裤的
lemmas.def_en: dressed in trousers

examples.en: In Victorian times, young boys were breeched around the age of six.
examples.zh: 在维多利亚时代，男童大约在六岁时开始换穿长裤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 breeched 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [化]双分子的, 有两个分子的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or affecting two molecules

examples.en: The chemist studied the kinetics of this rapid bimolecular gas reaction.
examples.zh: 化学家研究了这种快速双分子气体反应的动力学。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bimolecular 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: convex on both sides; shaped like a lentil

examples.en: A simple magnifying glass uses a biconvex lens to focus sunlight.
examples.zh: 普通的放大镜利用双凸透镜来聚焦太阳光。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 biconvex 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of numerous small flat Atlantic food fish having smooth skin

examples.en: The chef seasoned the fresh butterfish with lemon and grilled it.
examples.zh: 大厨用柠檬给新鲜的鲳鱼调味，然后进行烘烤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 butterfish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: lysis of plant or animal tissue by an internal process

examples.en: Cellular autolysis begins naturally shortly after an organism ceases to live.
examples.zh: 生物体死亡后不久，细胞的自身溶解便会自然开始。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 autolysis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 谄媚的, 过分称赞的
lemmas.def_en: obsequiously complimentary

examples.en: The pop star received dozens of adulatory reviews for her new album.
examples.zh: 这位流行歌星的新专辑收获了数十篇极尽赞美之词的评论。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 adulatory 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to appetite

examples.en: Smelling fresh bread triggered strong appetitive responses in the hungry patrons.
examples.zh: 闻到新鲜面包的香味激起了饥饿顾客强烈的食欲反应。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 appetitive 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: third from last

examples.en: In this polysyllabic word, the primary stress falls on the antepenultimate syllable.
examples.zh: 在这个多音节词中，主重音落在倒数第三个音节上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 antepenultimate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [植]耳状报春花,[动]耳螺属软体动物
lemmas.def_en: yellow-flowered primrose native to Alps; commonly cultivated

examples.en: The gardener took pride in cultivating a rare velvet-textured auricula in spring.
examples.zh: 园丁以在春季培育出一株罕见的天鹅绒质感耳状报春花为傲。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 auricula 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: prove to be false

examples.en: The defense attorney presented undeniable DNA evidence to confute the prosecutor's claim.
examples.zh: 辩方律师出示了无可辩驳的DNA证据，驳倒了检察官的主张。

lemmas.def_en: the speech act of refuting conclusively

family_guide.root_logic: 以 confute 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 改善, 改良, 变好
lemmas.def_en: to make better

examples.en: New environmental policies were enacted to meliorate urban air quality quickly.
examples.zh: 出台新的环境政策旨在迅速改善城市空气质量。

lemmas.def_en: the act of relieving ills and changing for the better

family_guide.root_logic: 以 meliorate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 扰乱, 搅乱, 弄乱
lemmas.def_en: destroy the arrangement or order of

examples.en: A sudden gust of wind disarranged all the papers on his desk.
examples.zh: 一阵突如其来的狂风弄乱了他桌上所有的文件。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 disarrange 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a pressure gauge for measuring blood pressure

examples.en: The clinic nurse wrapped the sphygmomanometer cuff firmly around my upper arm.
examples.zh: 诊所护士将血压计袖带紧紧裹在我的上臂上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sphygmomanometer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a measuring instrument for measuring the vital capacity of the lungs

examples.en: The nurse asked the patient to exhale firmly into the spirometer.
examples.zh: 护士让病人对着肺活量计用力呼气。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 spirometer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可压榨的, 可榨取的, 可敲诈的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being easily compressed

examples.en: The new honey bottle is made of soft, squeezable plastic material.
examples.zh: 这款新蜂蜜瓶是由柔软易挤压的塑料制成的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 squeezable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 日晒的, 被太阳晒得干而发硬的
lemmas.def_en: dried out by heat or excessive exposure to sunlight

examples.en: Lizards warmed themselves on the sunbaked stones beside the dusty trail.
examples.zh: 蜥蜴在尘土飞扬的小路旁被太阳晒得滚烫的石头上取暖。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sunbaked 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a hat with a broad brim that protects the face from direct exposure to the sun

examples.en: She wore a wide sunhat to protect her face during the hike.
examples.zh: 徒步旅行时，她戴了一顶宽边遮阳帽以保护面部。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sunhat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 职责以外的, 多余的, 非本质的, 不必要的
lemmas.def_en: more than is needed, desired, or required

examples.en: Offering to pay for his colleague's dinner was entirely supererogatory.
examples.zh: 主动为同事的晚餐买单完全是职责之外的举动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 supererogatory 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （尤指江河湖泊中的）水鸟, 水禽
lemmas.def_en: freshwater aquatic bird

examples.en: A solitary waterbird glided gracefully across the misty surface of the lake.
examples.zh: 一只孤独的水鸟在薄雾笼罩的湖面上优雅地滑行。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 waterbird 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 未决定的, 可疑的, 暧昧的, 暂停的, 悬而不决的
lemmas.def_en: (of a situation) characterized by or causing suspense

examples.en: The court imposed a suspensive condition before the contract could take effect.
examples.zh: 法院在合同生效前附加了一项中止性延缓条件。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 suspensive 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a watercourse that carries water away from a mill or water wheel or turbine

examples.en: Water rushed through the tailrace and returned smoothly to the main river.
examples.zh: 水流穿过尾水渠，平缓地流回主河道。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tailrace 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: dark and gloomy

examples.en: The adventurers cautiously entered the tenebrous depths of the ancient cavern.
examples.zh: 冒险者们小心翼翼地走入古老洞穴阴暗的深处。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tenebrous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不虚伪的, 老实的, 真实的
lemmas.def_en: coinciding with reality; - F.A.Olafson

examples.en: Modern instruments confirmed that the explorer's controversial account was entirely veridical.
examples.zh: 现代仪器证实，这位探险家备受争议的叙述完全属实。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 veridical 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: agitate by introducing air or compressed gas

examples.en: Brewers carefully sparge the grain bed with hot water to extract sugars.
examples.zh: 酿酒师用热水仔细喷淋麦糟层以萃取糖分。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sparge 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: uneven by virtue of having wrinkles or waves

examples.en: The dancer made smooth, wavelike motions with her arms across the stage.
examples.zh: 舞者在舞台上用双臂做着平缓如波浪般的动作。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wavelike 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: weathervane with a vane in the form of a rooster

examples.en: The copper weathercock on top of the old church turned in the wind.
examples.zh: 老教堂顶上的铜风标在风中旋转。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 weathercock 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 杀后立刻烹调, 插入(字句等)
lemmas.def_en: prepare for eating if or as if a spatchcock

examples.en: The editor refused to spatchcock random paragraphs into the finished article.
examples.zh: 编辑拒绝把随意的段落硬塞进已定稿的文章中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 spatchcock 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: informal term for sleep

examples.en: I desperately need to get some shuteye before the early morning flight.
examples.zh: 在赶清晨的航班之前，我急需睡上一觉。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shuteye 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 挖掘工作, 基础工作, 基本研究
lemmas.def_en: dull or routine preliminary work preparing for an undertaking

examples.en: Months of careful spadework were required before the scientific trial could begin.
examples.zh: 在科学试验开始前，需要进行数月细致的基础工作。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 spadework 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 拔毛, 脱毛法,头发脱落
lemmas.def_en: loss of hair; the result of removing hair

examples.en: Laser epilation has become a very popular method for permanent hair removal.
examples.zh: 激光脱毛已成为一种非常流行的永久脱毛方法。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 epilation 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the practice of making cuckolds; sexual conquests of married women

examples.en: Medieval comedies often used cuckoldry as a central theme for crude humor.
examples.zh: 中世纪喜剧常将通奸作为粗俗幽默的核心主题。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cuckoldry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a surgical instrument shaped like a scoop to remove tissue from a bodily cavity

examples.en: The surgeon used a small curette to gently scrape the damaged tissue.
examples.zh: 外科医生用一把小刮匙轻轻刮除了受损组织。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 curette 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a B vitamin that is used to treat pernicious anemia

examples.en: Vegans often take supplements containing cyanocobalamin to maintain their energy levels.
examples.zh: 严格素食者通常服用含有维生素B12的补充剂以保持精力。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cyanocobalamin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: having or characterized by or consisting of two syllables

examples.en: The teacher asked the young students to identify every disyllabic word.
examples.zh: 老师要求年幼的学生找出所有的双音节词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 disyllabic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a stupid person; these words are used to express a low opinion of someone's intelligence

examples.en: Only a complete dunderhead would leave all the windows open in the rain.
examples.zh: 只有十足的笨蛋才会在下雨时把所有窗户都开着。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dunderhead 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a port where merchandise can be imported and then exported without paying import duties

examples.en: Singapore quickly developed into a thriving global entrepot for international shipping.
examples.zh: 新加坡迅速发展成为繁荣的国际航运贸易转口港。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 entrepot 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (古希伯来人的干量单位)伊法
lemmas.def_en: an ancient Hebrew unit of dry measure equal to about a bushel

examples.en: The merchant measured out an ephah of barley according to ancient custom.
examples.zh: 商人按照古老的习俗量出了一伊法的大麦。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ephah 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a Japanese shrub that resembles members of the genus Spiraea; widely cultivated in many varieties for its dense panicles of flowers in many colors; often forced by florists for Easter blooming

examples.en: The white spirea bushes blossomed beautifully along the front garden fence.
examples.zh: 洁白的绣线菊灌木在花园前围栏旁绚丽地绽放。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 spirea 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [画]至上主义(1913 年出现在俄国的纯几何形抽象绘画艺术运动)
lemmas.def_en: a geometric abstractionist movement originated by Kazimir Malevich in Russia that influenced constructivism

examples.en: The gallery featured an exhibition exploring the geometric foundations of Russian suprematism.
examples.zh: 画廊举办了一场展览，探索俄罗斯至上主义的几何基础。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 suprematism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a measuring instrument for measuring viscosity

examples.en: The technician used a rotational viscometer to measure the motor oil's thickness.
examples.zh: 技术人员使用旋转黏度计测量了机油的稠度。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 viscometer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to thermal hydrometry

examples.en: The researcher conducted a thermogravimetric test to monitor the polymer's thermal decomposition.
examples.zh: 研究人员进行了热重分析测试，以监测聚合物的热分解过程。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 thermogravimetric 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 三百年的,三百周年纪念的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or completing a period of 300 years

examples.en: The historical coastal town organized grand parades to mark its tricentennial anniversary.
examples.zh: 这座历史悠久的沿海小镇组织了盛大的游行来纪念其建城三百周年。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tricentennial 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: one of a group of three sharing public administration or civil authority especially in ancient Rome

examples.en: Each Roman triumvir held immense power over vast territories across the empire.
examples.zh: 每位罗马三执政官都对帝国的广袤领土拥有巨大的统治权。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 triumvir 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (车架)下悬式的, 重心低的
lemmas.def_en: supported from above especially in a vehicle having springs attached to the axle from below

examples.en: The sports car features an underslung chassis designed to improve high-speed stability.
examples.zh: 这款跑车采用了下悬式底盘设计，旨在提升高速行驶时的稳定性。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 underslung 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a digital recording (as of a movie) on an optical disk that can be played on a computer or a television set

examples.en: He discovered a dusty laser videodisc inside the old television cabinet yesterday.
examples.zh: 他昨天在旧电视柜里发现了一张落满灰尘的激光影碟。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 videodisc 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: in a weak or pale or languid manner

examples.en: Recovering from the fever, she smiled wanly at her worried parents.
examples.zh: 刚从发烧中恢复过来的她，无力地对担忧的父母笑了笑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wanly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a building or outbuilding where laundry is done

examples.en: Villagers used to gather at the communal washhouse to scrub their laundry.
examples.zh: 村民们过去常常聚集在公共洗衣房里洗衣服。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 washhouse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a structurally different form of an element

examples.en: Diamond is a remarkably hard allotrope of carbon with unique optical properties.
examples.zh: 金刚石是碳的一种硬度极高的同素异形体，具有独特的光学性质。

lemmas.def_en: of or related to or exhibiting allotropism

examples.en: carbon and sulfur and phosphorus are allotropic elements

family_guide.root_logic: 以 allotrope 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: foam or froth on the sea

examples.en: Violent ocean waves broke against the cliffs, sending white spume into the air.
examples.zh: 汹涌的海浪拍打着悬崖，将白色的泡沫卷向空中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 spume 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a Hindu religious mendicant

examples.en: The wandering sannyasi renounced all worldly possessions to seek spiritual liberation.
examples.zh: 这位四处云游的印度托钵僧放弃了一切尘世财产以寻求精神解脱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sannyasi 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a pert or flirtatious young girl

examples.en: She delightfully portrayed a flirtatious soubrette in the lively comedic opera.
examples.zh: 她在那部生动活泼的喜剧歌剧中出色地饰演了一个轻浮俏皮的女子。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 soubrette 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a South African movie theater

examples.en: In the early twentieth century, travelling bioscope shows amazed rural audiences.
examples.zh: 在二十世纪初，巡回流动的早期电影放映机让乡间观众惊叹不已。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bioscope 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a cylindrical brush on a thin shaft that is used to clean bottles

examples.en: The gardener admired the vibrant red blooms of the blooming bottlebrush plant.
examples.zh: 园丁赞赏着盛开的红千层灌木上鲜艳的红色花朵。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bottlebrush 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a block made from charcoal or coal dust and burned as fuel

examples.en: He added another charcoal briquet to keep the outdoor barbecue grill hot.
examples.zh: 他又加了一块木炭煤砖，以保持户外烤架的温度。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 briquet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: extract of the heartwood of Acacia catechu used for dyeing and tanning and preserving fishnets and sails; formerly used medicinally

examples.en: Traditional artisans extracted dark catechu to dye natural fabrics rich brown hues.
examples.zh: 传统工匠提取深色儿茶，将天然织物染成浓郁的棕褐色。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 catechu 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: bug of temperate regions that infests especially beds and feeds on human blood

examples.en: The traveler inspected the old mattress carefully, fearing the bite of a chinch.
examples.zh: 旅客仔细检查了旧床垫，唯恐遭到臭虫的叮咬。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chinch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small intestines of hogs prepared as food

examples.en: My grandmother prepared a traditional Southern feast centered around boiled chitterlings.
examples.zh: 我的祖母准备了一顿以水煮猪小肠为核心的传统南方盛宴。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chitterlings 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (veterinary medicine) infestation with coccidia

examples.en: The poultry farmer quarantined the flock immediately after detecting signs of coccidiosis.
examples.zh: 家禽养殖户在发现球虫病迹象后立即隔离了鸡群。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 coccidiosis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: widely grown stout Old World hay and pasture grass

examples.en: The rooster defended its territory fiercely, flashing a sharp, curved cockspur.
examples.zh: 公鸡凶猛地捍卫自己的领地，亮出了锋利而弯曲的距。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cockspur 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a female ballet dancer

examples.en: The graceful danseuse performed a flawless pirouette before the enraptured audience.
examples.zh: 那位优雅的女芭蕾舞演员在着迷的观众面前完成了完美的单足旋转。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 danseuse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (of a flowering plant) having two cotyledons in the seed

examples.en: Sunflowers and beans are classic examples of dicotyledonous flowering plants.
examples.zh: 向日葵和豆类植物是典型的双子叶开花植物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dicotyledonous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: painful or difficult urination

examples.en: The patient visited the clinic complaining of severe dysuria and lower back pain.
examples.zh: 病人因严重的排尿困难和下背痛前往诊所就诊。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dysuria 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: infestation with larval echinococci (tapeworms)

examples.en: Health authorities launched a campaign in rural communities to eradicate echinococcosis.
examples.zh: 卫生部门在农村社区开展了一场根除包虫病的运动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 echinococcosis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an infant's repetition of sounds uttered by others

examples.en: Children with certain neurological conditions may display echolalia by repeating phrases.
examples.zh: 患有某些神经系统疾病的儿童可能会表现出模仿言语，重复他人的短语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 echolalia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 合并, 希腊与塞浦路斯合并运动
lemmas.def_en: the union of Greece and Cyprus (which is the goal of a group of Greek Cypriots)

examples.en: The political campaign for enosis sparked intense debates across the Mediterranean island.
examples.zh: 争取合并的政治运动在地中海该岛引发了激烈辩论。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 enosis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 尾声, 收场白, 闭幕词, 结尾部分, 跋, 后记
lemmas.def_en: a short speech (often in verse) addressed directly to the audience by an actor at the end of a play

examples.en: The brief epilog explained what happened to the characters ten years later.
examples.zh: 简短的后记交代了这些角色十年后的命运。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 epilog 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a fast narrow sailing ship of the Mediterranean

examples.en: We sailed down the Nile on a traditional wooden felucca at sunset.
examples.zh: 日落时分，我们乘着一艘传统的木质三桅小帆船沿尼罗河顺流而下。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 felucca 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 水泡, 气泡, 疱疹
lemmas.def_en: (pathology) an elevation of the skin filled with serous fluid

examples.en: A tiny fluid-filled bleb formed on his skin after the mild burn.
examples.zh: 轻度烧伤后，他的皮肤上长出了一个充满液体的小水泡。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bleb 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the framework of a bed

examples.en: We bought a sturdy wooden bedframe to support the heavy new mattress.
examples.zh: 我们买了一个结实的木床架来支撑厚重的新床垫。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bedframe 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a tremor preceding an earthquake

examples.en: The mild foreshock rattled windows minutes before the major earthquake struck.
examples.zh: 大地震来临前数分钟，轻微的前震震得窗户作响。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 foreshock 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 狂饮的, 闹宴的, 酒神的
lemmas.def_en: used of riotously drunken merrymaking

examples.en: The harvest festival turned into a bacchic celebration filled with wine and dancing.
examples.zh: 丰收节演变成了一场充斥着美酒与歌舞的狂欢狂饮。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bacchic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 女新闻记者; 女编辑; 女报刊经售人
lemmas.def_en: a female newsperson

examples.en: The experienced newswoman reported live from the center of the disaster zone.
examples.zh: 这位经验丰富的女记者在灾区中心进行了现场直播。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 newswoman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: nearest to or facing toward the axis of an organ or organism

examples.en: The adaxial surface of the leaf was dark green, glossy, and smooth.
examples.zh: 叶片的近轴面呈深绿色，有光泽且光滑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 adaxial 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 猛禽的巢, 高处的房子, 高处的城堡
lemmas.def_en: the lofty nest of a bird of prey (such as a hawk or eagle)

examples.en: The eagle returned to its rugged aery high on the mountain cliff.
examples.zh: 老鹰回到了它位于悬崖高处的崎岖巢穴。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 aery 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of rocks, deposits, etc.; found in a place other than where they and their constituents were formed

examples.en: Geologists discovered allochthonous rock layers transported by tectonic forces over vast distances.
examples.zh: 地质学家发现了因构造力作用被远距离搬运的外来移置岩层。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 allochthonous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: in no manner; in no way

examples.en: I tried fixing the broken engine, but it wouldn't start up nohow.
examples.zh: 我试着修好坏掉的引擎，但无论如何它都发动不起来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nohow 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: scalelike structure between the base of the wing and the halter of a two-winged fly

examples.en: The bird extended its alula to maintain stability during a steep landing.
examples.zh: 鸟儿展开小翼羽，以便在陡峭降落时保持稳定。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 alula 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: sweet pulpy tropical fruit with thick scaly rind and shiny black seeds

examples.en: Historians documented the local political decisions influenced by the Annon family estate.
examples.zh: 历史学家记录了受安农家族庄园影响的当地政治决策。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 annon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: preceding death

examples.en: The forensic pathologist examined the antemortem injuries to determine the victim's timeline.
examples.zh: 法医病理学家检查了临死前的损伤，以确定受害者生前的时间线。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 antemortem 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the antiparticle of a quark

examples.en: Physicists observed the brief annihilation of a quark and an antiquark.
examples.zh: 物理学家观察到了一个夸克与一个反夸克的短暂湮灭。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 antiquark 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the belief that God can be known to humans only in terms of what He is not (such as `God is unknowable')

examples.en: He preferred an apophatic theology, describing the divine purely through negation.
examples.zh: 他偏好否定神学，纯粹通过否定形式来描述神圣。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 apophatic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or consisting of an appendage or appendages; especially the limbs

examples.en: The human appendicular skeleton includes the bones of the arms and legs.
examples.zh: 人类的附肢骨骼包括手臂和腿部的骨骼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 appendicular 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 星穴, 星点(枕、顶、颞三骨会合处)

examples.en: The neurosurgeon used the asterion as a cranial landmark to guide the incision.
examples.zh: 神经外科医生将星穴作为颅骨标志来指导切口位置。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 asterion 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: one billionth (1/1,000,000,000) gram

examples.en: The laboratory test can detect just a single nanogram of the toxin.
examples.zh: 该实验室检测甚至可以测出仅一纳克的毒素。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nanogram 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any membranous gap between the bones of the cranium in an infant or fetus

examples.en: The pediatrician gently examined the soft fontanel on the infant's head.
examples.zh: 儿科医生轻轻检查了婴儿头部柔软的囟门。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fontanel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可弄干净的, 可扫除干净的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being cleaned

examples.en: We chose a dining table with an easily cleanable surface for convenience.
examples.zh: 为了方便，我们选了一张表面极易擦洗干净的餐桌。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cleanable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 地理统计；地理性；地理上的
lemmas.def_en: study of the earth's surface; includes people's responses to topography and climate and soil and vegetation

examples.en: Marketers analyzed regional geographics to customize advertising campaigns for diverse locations.
examples.zh: 营销人员分析了区域地理特征，以便为不同地点定制广告活动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 geographics 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a large marine food fish common on the coasts of Australia, New Zealand, and southern Africa

examples.en: The fisherman caught a fresh snoek off the coast for dinner tonight.
examples.zh: 渔民今晚在沿海捕获了一条新鲜的杖鱼作为晚餐。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 snoek 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: swelling of the optic disc (where the optic nerve enters the eyeball); usually associated with an increase in intraocular pressure

examples.en: The eye examination revealed papilledema, suggesting increased pressure inside the patient's skull.
examples.zh: 眼部检查发现视神经乳头水肿，提示患者颅内压升高。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 papilledema 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an inhabitant of a plains region (especially the Great Plains of North America)

examples.en: The experienced plainsman navigated the vast, open grasslands with incredible ease and skill.
examples.zh: 这位经验丰富的平原居民驾轻就熟地在辽阔的草原上穿行。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 plainsman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: beyond or distal to a ganglion (referring especially to the unmyelinated fibers that originate from cells in autonomic ganglia)

examples.en: The postganglionic fibers release neurotransmitters to regulate the activity of target organs.
examples.zh: 节后纤维释放神经递质以调节靶器官的活动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 postganglionic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: move in a gyrating fashion

examples.en: As the spinning top slows down, its axis begins to precess slowly.
examples.zh: 随着陀螺转速变慢，它的轴线开始缓慢进动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 precess 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a short-lived radioactive metallic element formed from uranium and disintegrating into actinium and then into lead

examples.en: Protactinium is a rare and highly radioactive element found in uranium ores.
examples.zh: 镤是一种在铀矿石中发现的稀有且具有高放射性的元素。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 protactinium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a benign tumor of connective tissue containing jellylike material

examples.en: Surgeons successfully removed a benign myxoma from the patient's left atrium yesterday.
examples.zh: 外科医生昨天成功从患者左心房切除了一个良性粘液瘤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 myxoma 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the act of despoiling a country in warfare

examples.zh: 这座古城沦为入侵军队无情掠夺和抢劫的牺牲品。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rapine 为核心的派生词族。

examples.zh: 那个小无赖总能找到巧妙的办法在晚饭前偷饼干吃。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scalawag 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: informal terms for the nose

examples.zh: 万圣节时他戴着一副配有荒唐大塑料鼻子的搞怪眼镜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 schnoz 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 便签簿,中间结果暂存器
lemmas.def_en: (computer science) a high-speed internal memory used for temporary storage of preliminary information

examples.en: Keep a digital scratchpad open on your desktop to jot down quick notes.
examples.zh: 在桌面上打开一个数字便签簿，以便快速记录笔记。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scratchpad 为核心的派生词族。

examples.zh: 当他决定娶一位非犹太姑娘时，他守旧的祖母大为震惊。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shiksa 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: development of ova

examples.zh: 在卵子发生过程中，单个二倍体细胞通过减数分裂发育为成熟卵子。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 oogenesis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 放射免疫测定, 放射免疫测定法
lemmas.def_en: immunoassay of a substance that has been radioactively labeled

examples.en: The laboratory used a sensitive radioimmunoassay to detect tiny hormone levels in blood.
examples.zh: 实验室使用灵敏的放射免疫测定法检测血液中微量的激素水平。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 radioimmunoassay 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: thin sheet of sponge cake spread with jelly and then rolled up to make a cylindrical cake

examples.en: She served sweet strawberry jellyroll slices alongside fresh hot tea for dessert.
examples.zh: 她端上甜美的水蜜桃酱卷心蛋糕切片配热茶作为甜点。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 jellyroll 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: having or resembling fibers especially fibers used in making cordage such as those of jute

examples.en: The cargo was secured to the wooden deck with strong, thick hempen ropes.
examples.zh: 货物用结实粗壮的大麻绳固定在木质甲板上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hempen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 灰泥搅拌托板, 学士帽
lemmas.def_en: a square board with a handle underneath; used by masons to hold or carry mortar

examples.en: Each proud graduate tossed a black mortarboard high into the sunny afternoon sky.
examples.zh: 每位骄傲的毕业生都将黑色学士帽高高抛向洒满阳光的午后天空。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mortarboard 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a woman employed as a chaperon in a residence for young people

examples.en: The kind housemother always baked delicious treats for the homesick students on weekends.
examples.zh: 善良的女舍监周末总会为想家的学生烘焙美味点心。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 housemother 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 强求, 硬要；强求, 纠缠
lemmas.def_en: beg persistently and urgently

examples.en: Desperate vendors continued to importune tourists to buy cheap souvenirs near the monument.
examples.zh: 心急的摊贩在纪念碑附近不停纠缠游客购买廉价纪念品。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 importune 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: insistent solicitation and entreaty

examples.en: Tired of his constant importunity, she finally agreed to lend him the money.
examples.zh: 厌倦了他不断的强求，她终于同意借钱给他。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 importunity 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [医]离子电渗疗法, 电离子透入疗法
lemmas.def_en: therapy that uses a local electric current to introduce the ions of a medicine into the tissues

examples.en: The clinic uses iontophoresis to deliver anti-inflammatory medication directly into the patient's joint.
examples.zh: 该诊所使用电离子透入疗法直接将消炎药注入患者的关节中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 iontophoresis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 公马和母驴所生的骡子
lemmas.def_en: hybrid offspring of a male horse and a female donkey or ass; usually sterile

examples.en: A hinny is produced by crossing a male horse with a female donkey.
examples.zh: 公马和母驴交配会生出驴骡。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hinny 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (folklore) a female ogre

examples.en: In the fairy tale, the fearsome ogress guarded a hoard of stolen gold.
examples.zh: 在童话故事中，可怕的食人女妖守卫着一堆偷来的金子。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ogress 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [法] 构成盗窃罪的, 犯盗窃罪的, 偷窃的
lemmas.def_en: having a disposition to steal

examples.en: The security guard quickly noticed the shoplifter's larcenous intentions near the jewelry counter.
examples.zh: 保安很快注意到了小偷在珠宝柜台附近企图行窃的意图。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 larcenous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 哈里发(伊斯兰教执掌政教大权的领袖的称号), 某些穆斯林国家对官员等的尊称
lemmas.def_en: the civil and religious leader of a Muslim state considered to be a representative of Allah on earth

examples.en: The ancient empire expanded rapidly under the strong leadership of the second kalif.
examples.zh: 在第二任哈里发的强有力领导下，这个古老帝国迅速扩张。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kalif 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: river boat with a shallow draught and a keel but no sails; used to carry freight; moved by rowing or punting or towing

examples.en: Traders loaded supplies onto the wooden keelboat before heading up the shallow river.
examples.zh: 商人们把补给装上木质龙骨艇，然后溯浅河而上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 keelboat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: people descended from a common ancestor

examples.en: He invited all his kinsfolk to the countryside to celebrate his fiftieth birthday.
examples.zh: 他邀请了所有亲属到乡下庆祝他的五十岁生日。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kinsfolk 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 寡妇与亡夫兄弟的结婚
lemmas.def_en: the biblical institution whereby a man must marry the widow of his childless brother in order to maintain the brother's line

examples.en: Under the ancient law of levirate, a man was obliged to marry his brother's widow.
examples.zh: 根据古老的夫兄弟婚习俗，男子有义务迎娶其亡兄或弟的遗孀。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 levirate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [船]龙骨的后部, 导流尾鳍
lemmas.def_en: a brace that extends from the rear of the keel to support the rudderpost

examples.en: The surfboard's damaged skeg made it difficult to maintain stability in rough waves.
examples.zh: 冲浪板损坏的尾鳍使其难以在汹涌的波浪中保持稳定。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 skeg 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: iron ore in the form of ferrous carbonate

examples.en: Miners extracted valuable iron ore from the newly discovered deposit of crystalline siderite.
examples.zh: 矿工们从新发现的结晶菱铁矿矿床中提取出了宝贵的铁矿石。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 siderite 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a room to which a sick person is confined

examples.en: The nurse kept the sickroom quiet and well-ventilated to aid the patient's recovery.
examples.zh: 护士保持病房安静和通风良好，以帮助病人康复。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sickroom 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: not of natural origin; prepared or made artificially

examples.en: Doctors often prescribe semisynthetic antibiotics to treat bacterial infections that resist natural penicillin.
examples.zh: 医生通常开具半合成抗生素来治疗对天然青霉素耐药的细菌感染。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 semisynthetic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 五彩拉毛粉饰, 五彩拉毛陶瓷
lemmas.def_en: a ceramic or mural decoration made by scratching off a surface layer to reveal the ground

examples.en: The historic villa was famous for its exterior walls decorated with intricate sgraffito.
examples.zh: 这座历史悠久的别墅以其装饰着精美刮画的外墙而闻名。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sgraffito 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [微]呼肠孤病毒, 呼吸道肠道病毒
lemmas.def_en: any of a group of non-arboviruses including the rotavirus causing infant enteritis

examples.en: Researchers studied how the reovirus spreads among wild animals during the cold winter.
examples.zh: 研究人员研究了呼肠孤病毒在寒冷冬季如何在野生动物中传播。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 reovirus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 地方主义, 地方偏见
lemmas.def_en: a partiality for some particular place

examples.en: Growing sectionalism between the northern and southern provinces threatened to split the nation.
examples.zh: 南北各省之间日益加剧的地方偏见威胁着国家的统一。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sectionalism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [动]樽海鞘(纽鳃樽科尾过动物)
lemmas.def_en: minute floating marine tunicate having a transparent body with an opening at each end

examples.en: The transparent salp drifted gently through the ocean current while filtering food particles.
examples.zh: 透明的樽海鞘在洋流中缓缓漂流，同时过滤食物微粒。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 salp 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: one of a series of similar body segments into which some animals are divided longitudinally

examples.en: Each embryonic somite eventually develops into specific segments of muscle and spinal bone.
examples.zh: 每个胚胎体节最终都会发育成特定的肌肉和脊椎骨节段。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 somite 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 毒鱼藤；三叶木蓝；三叶鱼藤
lemmas.def_en: small fast-growing spiny deciduous Chinese orange tree bearing sweetly scented flowers and decorative but inedible fruit: used as a stock in grafting and for hedges

examples.en: The gardener planted a hardy citrus trifoliata near the stone wall for protection.
examples.zh: 园丁在石墙附近种了一棵耐寒的枳作为防护。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 trifoliata 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a stopping

examples.en: The exhausted soldiers prayed for a brief surcease from the relentless enemy shelling.
examples.zh: 疲惫不堪的士兵们祈求敌军无休止的炮击能短暂停止。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 surcease 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 亵渎语, 坏话, 咒骂
lemmas.def_en: profane or obscene expression usually of surprise or anger

examples.en: The referee penalized the angry player after he shouted a loud swearword.
examples.zh: 当愤怒的球员大声喊出一句脏话后，裁判对他进行了处罚。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 swearword 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: burn superficially or lightly

examples.en: I singed my eyebrows

family_guide.root_logic: 以 swingeing 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 促甲状腺素, 促甲状腺激素
lemmas.def_en: anterior pituitary hormone that stimulates the function of the thyroid gland

examples.en: The blood test showed abnormal levels of thyrotropin, indicating a potential thyroid problem.
examples.zh: 血液检查显示促甲状腺素水平异常，表明可能存在甲状腺问题。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 thyrotropin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 三色的, 用三色的, 三色视的
lemmas.def_en: having or involving three colors

examples.en: Most humans have trichromatic vision, allowing them to perceive a wide spectrum of colors.
examples.zh: 大多数人具有三色视觉，使他们能够感知广泛的颜色光谱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 trichromatic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: leave suddenly

examples.en: The security guard approached, so the trespassing teenagers decided to vamoose immediately.
examples.zh: 保安走了过来，于是非法闯入的青少年决定立刻开溜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vamoose 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: tour the country in order to solicit votes for an election

examples.en: The candidate planned to whistlestop across the Midwest during the final campaign week.
examples.zh: 候选人计划在竞选最后一周横穿中西部地区作巡回宣传。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 whistlestop 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an animal skin (usually a goatskin) that forms a bag and is used to hold and dispense wine

examples.en: The traveler quenched his thirst with cool water from a leather wineskin.
examples.zh: 旅行者从皮酒囊里倒出凉水解渴。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wineskin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: being one more than ninety

examples.en: Skewed XCI patterns are often analyzed to understand female carriers of genetic disorders.
examples.zh: 人们常通过分析偏向性X染色体失活模式来理解女性遗传病携带者。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 xci 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 亚迪（牙买加国际犯罪组织成员）
lemmas.def_en: member of an international gang of Jamaican criminals who sell drugs and violence

examples.en: Police launched an undercover operation to dismantle the violent yardie network in London.
examples.zh: 警方展开了一项卧底行动，以瓦解伦敦一个暴力的亚迪犯罪网络。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 yardie 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: telegraphy that uses transmission by radio rather than by wire

examples.en: Before satellite communications, ships relied heavily on radiotelegraphy for long-distance messages.
examples.zh: 在卫星通信出现之前，船只主要依靠无线电报进行远距离联络。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 radiotelegraphy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: having branches

examples.en: The botanist carefully documented the ramose structure of the newly discovered coral fungus.
examples.zh: 植物学家仔细记录了新发现的珊瑚菌的分枝结构。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ramose 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a voluntary played at the end of a religious service

examples.en: The organist played a majestic postlude as the congregation slowly exited the church.
examples.zh: 会众缓缓离开教堂时，风琴师演奏了一首庄严的后奏曲。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 postlude 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a quantum of energy (in a crystal lattice or other system) that has position and momentum and can in some respects be regarded as a particle

examples.en: Physicists measured the energy levels of each quasiparticle within the superconducting material.
examples.zh: 物理学家测量了超导材料内每个准粒子的能级。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 quasiparticle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 象轿(象背上设置有篷盖的座席), 象舆
lemmas.def_en: a (usually canopied) seat for riding on the back of a camel or elephant

examples.en: The royal guest climbed into the decorated howdah atop the ceremonial elephant.
examples.zh: 尊贵的客人登上了礼仪象背上装饰华丽的象轿。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 howdah 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 龙脑香科树(尤指羯布罗香)
lemmas.def_en: tree of the family Dipterocarpaceae

examples.en: Towering dipterocarp trees dominate the dense canopy of the Southeast Asian rainforest.
examples.zh: 高耸的龙脑香科树木遮蔽了东南亚雨林茂密的树冠层。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dipterocarp 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a jamb for a door

examples.en: A simple wooden sign was nailed securely to the sturdy front doorpost.
examples.zh: 一块简单的木质标识被牢牢钉在坚固的正门门柱上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 doorpost 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a diocese of the Eastern Orthodox Church

examples.en: The newly appointed bishop was sent overseas to administer the growing exarchate.
examples.zh: 新任命的主教被派往海外管理这个不断发展的督主教区。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 exarchate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a parent who murders his own son or daughter

examples.en: The tragic filicide shocked the quiet suburban community and prompted a murder investigation.
examples.zh: 这起令人悲痛的杀害亲子案震惊了宁静的郊区社区，并引发了谋杀调查。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 filicide 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [医]黄〔热病〕病毒：披膜病毒的一个亚类
lemmas.def_en: animal viruses belonging to the family Flaviviridae

examples.en: Dengue fever is caused by a flavivirus transmitted primarily by female mosquitoes.
examples.zh: 登革热是由主要由雌性蚊子传播的黄病毒引起的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 flavivirus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 弯曲的, 动摇不定的, 不稳定的, 波状的
lemmas.def_en: having turns or windings

examples.en: A flexuous path wound gently through the hills, leading travelers to the hidden spring.
examples.zh: 一条蜿蜒的小径穿过丘陵，指引旅行者前往隐秘的泉水。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 flexuous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a restless seeker after amusement or social companionship

examples.en: Known as a restless gadabout, he rarely stayed in one city for long.
examples.zh: 作为一个不安分的浪荡子，他很少在同一个城市久居。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gadabout 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a Spanish female Gypsy

examples.en: The graceful gitana captivated the entire audience with her passionate flamenco performance.
examples.zh: 优雅的吉卜赛女人以热情的弗拉门戈舞蹈表演迷倒了全场观众。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gitana 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: used of small deformed creatures

examples.en: The eccentric toy maker smiled, showing a gnomish face full of playful wrinkles.
examples.zh: 古怪的玩具匠笑了，露出一张宛如侏儒般布满顽皮皱纹的脸。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gnomish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a variety of albatross with black feet

examples.en: A solitary goonie soared effortlessly above the crashing waves of the Pacific Ocean.
examples.zh: 一只孤独的信天翁在太平洋汹涌的波涛之上轻松翱翔。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 goonie 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small goat antelope with small conical horns; of southern Asian mountains

examples.en: The agile goral leaped effortlessly across the steep rocky ledges of the mountain.
examples.zh: 敏捷的斑羚在陡峭的高山岩架间轻盈跃过。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 goral 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 绿市集；绿市广场；绿色市场
lemmas.def_en: an open-air marketplace for farm products

examples.en: Every Saturday morning, locals flock to the bustling greenmarket for fresh organic produce.
examples.zh: 每逢周六早晨，当地人便涌向热闹的绿色市场购买新鲜的有机农产品。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 greenmarket 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a sweet colorless, viscous, hygroscopic liquid used as an antifreeze and in brake fluid and also as a humectant in cosmetics and personal care items although it can be absorbed through the skin with harmful effects

examples.en: The cosmetic chemist selected plant-derived propanediol as a gentle moisturizing ingredient.
examples.zh: 化妆品化学家选择了植物来源的丙二醇作为温和的保湿成分。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 propanediol 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: in the preceding part of the current text

examples.en: All terms hereinbefore mentioned shall remain effective until the end of this year.
examples.zh: 前文所提及的所有条款在今年年底前均保持有效。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hereinbefore 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: ice crystals forming a white deposit (especially on objects outside)

examples.en: In the early morning, a delicate layer of hoarfrost covered the winter garden.
examples.zh: 清晨，一层薄薄的白霜覆盖了冬日的花园。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hoarfrost 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a whip for controlling horses

examples.en: The angry rider gripped his leather horsewhip tightly while inspecting the muddy stable.
examples.zh: 愤怒的骑手紧握皮马鞭，视察着泥泞的马厩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 horsewhip 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the univalent cation R-N:N- (where R is an aromatic hydrocarbon); found in salts that are used in manufacturing azo dyes

examples.en: The chemist used a reactive diazonium salt to synthesize the new bright dye.
examples.zh: 化学家使用一种高活性的重氮盐来合成这种新型鲜艳染料。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 diazonium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: remove the claws from

examples.en: Vets strongly advise against choosing to declaw cats due to long-term health risks.
examples.zh: 由于长期的健康风险，兽医强烈建议不要为猫去除爪子。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 declaw 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a thief who steals from the pockets or purses of others in public places

examples.en: A skilled cutpurse took advantage of the crowded market to steal gold coins.
examples.zh: 一名熟练的扒手利用拥挤的市场偷走了金币。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cutpurse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a sauce like hollandaise but made with white wine and tarragon and shallots instead of lemon juice

examples.en: He poured warm bearnaise sauce over the freshly grilled steak before serving it.
examples.zh: 上菜前，他在刚烤好的牛排上淋上了温热的法式蛋黄酱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bearnaise 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: gradually increasing in tempo

examples.en: The conductor signaled an accelerando passage, and the orchestra played with rising energy.
examples.zh: 指挥示意进入渐快段落，管弦乐团随之以愈发高涨的活力演奏。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 accelerando 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a woman ambassador

examples.en: The ambassadress represented her country with great elegance at the international summit.
examples.zh: 女大使在国际峰会上以极其优雅的风姿代表了她的国家。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ambassadress 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: mottled curly-grained wood of Pterocarpus indicus

examples.en: The craftsman built an exquisite jewelry box using rare and beautifully figured amboyna.
examples.zh: 工匠用稀有且花纹优美的青龙木制作了一个精致的首饰盒。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 amboyna 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: capable of being partitioned

examples.en: The collected survey data is clean and fully analyzable by our research team.
examples.zh: 收集到的调查数据很清晰，完全可供我们研究团队进行分析。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 analyzable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 呼吸暂停的, 窒息的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to apnea

examples.en: The monitor alerted the nurses whenever the sleeping patient experienced an apneic event.
examples.zh: 每当熟睡的患者发生呼吸暂停事件时，监护仪就会提醒护士。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 apneic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 女飞行员, (飞机)女驾驶员
lemmas.def_en: a woman aviator

examples.en: The daring young aviatrix completed her solo flight across the wide ocean safely.
examples.zh: 那位勇敢的年轻女飞行员安全完成了飞越广阔大洋的单人飞行。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 aviatrix 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (astronomy) the common center of mass around which two or more bodies revolve

examples.en: The moon and Earth orbit around a shared barycenter located inside our planet.
examples.zh: 月球和地球围绕位于地球内部的一个共同质心旋转。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 barycenter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a branch of biology that studies biological phenomena and observations by means of statistical analysis

examples.en: Modern clinics rely on advanced biometry to estimate life expectancy and health trends.
examples.zh: 现代诊所依靠先进的寿命测定技术来评估预期寿命和健康趋势。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 biometry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 用杯吸法者, 用吸器放血者
lemmas.def_en: a cup of tea

examples.en: The skilled cupper placed warm glass cups carefully across the athlete's sore back.
examples.zh: 熟练的拔罐师将温热的玻璃罐仔细放置在运动员酸痛的背部。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cupper 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 园丁鸟(产于澳洲和新几内亚)
lemmas.def_en: any of various birds of the Australian region whose males build ornamented structures resembling bowers in order to attract females

examples.en: The male bowerbird decorated his intricate nest with colorful plastic caps to attract mates.
examples.zh: 雄性园丁鸟用彩色的塑料瓶盖装饰其精巧的巢穴以吸引配偶。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bowerbird 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: relieving gas in the alimentary tract (colic or flatulence or griping)

examples.en: Drinking warm peppermint tea provides a carminative effect that helps relieve painful bloating.
examples.zh: 饮用温热的薄荷茶具有驱风排气的作用，有助于缓解胀气疼痛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 carminative 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 新入教者, 新信徒, 初学者
lemmas.def_en: a new convert being taught the principles of Christianity by a catechist

examples.en: The young catechumen studied religious history diligently before receiving her official baptism ceremony.
examples.zh: 年轻的初学教友在接受正式洗礼仪式之前，勤奋地学习宗教历史。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 catechumen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: shrubby tree closely related to the Allegheny chinkapin but with larger leaves; southern midwestern United States

examples.en: We found a sturdy chinquapin tree dropping small edible nuts along the forest trail.
examples.zh: 我们沿着森林小径发现了一棵结满可食小坚果的健壮矮栗树。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chinquapin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a cavity in the mesoderm of an embryo that gives rise in humans to the pleural cavity and pericardial cavity and peritoneal cavity

examples.en: The presence of a fluid-filled coelom is a key evolutionary milestone in complex animals.
examples.zh: 充满液体的体腔的存在是复杂动物的一个关键进化里程碑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 coelom 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the act of sexual procreation between a man and a woman; the man's penis is inserted into the woman's vagina and excited until orgasm and ejaculation occur

examples.en: Certain animal species only engage in coition during specific, highly regulated breeding seasons.
examples.zh: 某些动物物种仅在特定且严格受控的繁殖季节进行交媾。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 coition 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a liquid that boils at below -160 C and is used as a refrigerant

examples.en: Liquid nitrogen is a commonly used cryogen for preserving biological samples at low temperatures.
examples.zh: 液氮是一种常用于在低温下保存生物样本的致冷剂。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cryogen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a husband who keeps house while his wife earns the family income

examples.en: After leaving his corporate job, he happily embraced his new role as a househusband.
examples.zh: 离开企业工作后，他愉快地接受了操持家务的全职丈夫这一新角色。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 househusband 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: acting like a clown or buffoon

examples.en: The children laughed heartily at the colorful characters in the lively harlequinade.
examples.zh: 孩子们看着滑稽表演中形形色色的人物，开怀大笑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 harlequinade 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [植](20世纪60 年代从亚洲引进美国的) 软水草
lemmas.def_en: submersed plant with whorled lanceolate leaves and solitary axillary flowers; Old World plant naturalized in southern United States and clogging Florida's waterways

examples.en: The invasive hydrilla quickly choked the lake, blocking sunlight from native plants.
examples.zh: 这种入侵性黑藻迅速蔓延并堵塞了湖泊，遮挡了本土植物的光照。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hydrilla 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of various plants of the genus Peperomia; grown primarily for their often succulent foliage

examples.en: She placed a potted peperomia on her desk because it needs minimal care.
examples.zh: 她在书桌上放了一盆豆瓣绿，因为它几乎不需要怎么打理。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 peperomia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: found in moist places as rounded jellylike colonies

examples.en: Colonies of nostoc formed gelatinous green blobs on the damp gravel path.
examples.zh: 潮湿的碎石小路上，念珠藻群落形成了胶状的绿色斑块。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nostoc 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 顽固, 执拗, 冷酷
lemmas.def_en: resoluteness by virtue of being unyielding and inflexible

examples.en: His sheer obduracy prevented the committee from reaching any sensible compromise today.
examples.zh: 他的极度顽固阻碍了委员会今天达成任何合理的妥协。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 obduracy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a macintosh made from cotton fabric treated with oil and pigment to make it waterproof

examples.en: The old fisherman pulled his yellow oilskin tight against the driving coastal rain.
examples.zh: 老渔民裹紧了身上的黄色油布雨衣，抵御沿海连绵的暴雨。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 oilskin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of various fragrant aromatic herbs of the genus Origanum used as seasonings

examples.en: She dried fresh origanum from her garden to use in homemade pasta sauce.
examples.zh: 她把花园里摘的新鲜牛至晾干，用来调制自制意面酱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 origanum 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: without limits in extent or size or quantity

examples.en: Standing on the cliff, she gazed out at the illimitable expanse of ocean.
examples.zh: 站在悬崖上，她凝视着那片无边无际的辽阔海洋。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 illimitable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any member of the genus Paramecium

examples.en: Under the microscope, the tiny paramecia darted rapidly across the water drop.
examples.zh: 在显微镜下，微小的草履虫在水滴中快速穿梭。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 paramecia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (黎巴嫩的)右翼基督教民兵, 长枪党党员, 法朗吉党党员
lemmas.def_en: a Spanish member of General Franco's political party

examples.en: The Phalangist militia played a significant and controversial role during the civil war.
examples.zh: 长枪党民兵在内战期间扮演了重要且饱受争议的角色。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 phalangist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: infestation of the body by the larvae of flies (usually through a wound or other opening) or any disease resulting from such infestation

examples.en: The veterinarian promptly treated the stray dog's wound to prevent severe myiasis.
examples.zh: 兽医立即对流浪狗的伤口进行了处理，以防止严重的蝇蛆病。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 myiasis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (昆虫)食植(物)的, 食叶类的
lemmas.def_en: (of animals) feeding on plants

examples.en: These phytophagous beetles can defoliate entire crop fields in just a few days.
examples.zh: 这些植食性甲虫仅用几天时间就能啃光整片农田的叶子。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 phytophagous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of several skin disorders characterized by shedding dry flakes of skin

examples.en: The doctor diagnosed her mild, scaly skin rash as a harmless form of pityriasis.
examples.zh: 医生诊断她身上轻微的鳞状皮疹为一种无害的糠疹。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pityriasis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 玩具箱, 私人用品箱
lemmas.def_en: a box for a child's toys and personal things (especially at a boarding school)

examples.en: The boy kept all his favorite wooden soldiers safe inside his old playbox.
examples.zh: 男孩把他所有心爱的木制士兵玩具妥善地保存在旧玩具箱里。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 playbox 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small enough to be carried in a garment pocket

examples.en: This compact digital camera is truly pocketable and perfect for casual everyday use.
examples.zh: 这款紧凑型数码相机小巧便携，非常适合日常随手使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pocketable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: plaything consisting of a toy gun that makes a popping sound

examples.en: The toddler giggled happily every time the cork popped from his toy popgun.
examples.zh: 每次玩具枪的软木塞发出砰的声响，蹒跚学步的孩子都会开心地咯咯笑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 popgun 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or occurring during the time following a glacial period

examples.en: Scientists discovered remarkable ancient animal bones preserved in the postglacial peat bog.
examples.zh: 科学家在冰河期后的泥炭沼泽中发现了保存完好的古代动物骨骼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 postglacial 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the act of saying no to a request

examples.en: Tired of endless naysaying, the young entrepreneur decided to follow her creative vision.
examples.zh: 厌倦了无休止的唱反调，这位年轻的企业家决定践行自己的创意构想。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 naysaying 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: <美>（非婚同居者分居后经法院判定由一方付给另一方的）同居生活费, 同居津贴
lemmas.def_en: support paid by one half of an unmarried partnership after the relationship ends

examples.en: After a bitter breakup, the actor sued his former partner for substantial palimony.
examples.zh: 在痛苦的分手后，该演员起诉前同居伴侣以索要巨额同居赡养费。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 palimony 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 蓍属植物, 狐尾藻属植物
lemmas.def_en: ubiquitous strong-scented mat-forming Eurasian herb of wasteland, hedgerow or pasture having narrow serrate leaves and small usually white florets; widely naturalized in North America

examples.en: Dense mats of Eurasian milfoil began to disrupt native fish in the river.
examples.zh: 茂密的水生狐尾藻团块开始干扰河中本土鱼类的生存。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 milfoil 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a person who favors a political philosophy of progress and reform and the protection of civil liberties

examples.en: As a dedicated liberalist, he advocated tirelessly for civil liberties and free speech.
examples.zh: 作为一名坚定的自由主义者，他不懈地倡导公民自由与言论自由。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 liberalist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 列在陪审员名单, 从陪审员名单中选定
lemmas.def_en: enter into a list of prospective jurors

examples.en: The court worked for three days to impanel an impartial and competent jury.
examples.zh: 法院花了三天时间选定了一个公正且合格的陪审团。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 impanel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: abnormally heavy or prolonged menstruation; can be a symptom of uterine tumors and can lead to anemia if prolonged

examples.en: Her doctor prescribed medication to manage the chronic menorrhagia affecting her health.
examples.zh: 医生给她开了药，以调理影响她健康的长期月经过多问题。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 menorrhagia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a woman with whom you are in love or have an intimate relationship

examples.en: The wealthy artist spent the entire summer painting portraits of his mysterious inamorata.
examples.zh: 这位富有的艺术家整个夏天都在为他神秘的情人画肖像。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inamorata 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: produce a literary work

examples.en: The poet sat down by candlelight to indite a heartfelt letter to his muse.
examples.zh: 诗人着烛光坐下，满怀深情地给他的缪斯写信。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 indite 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to interoception

examples.en: Mindfulness meditation can enhance your interoceptive awareness of hunger and heart rate.
examples.zh: 正念冥想可以增强你对饥饿和心率的内感受感知。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 interoceptive 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small birds resembling warblers but having some of the habits of titmice

examples.en: A tiny golden-crowned kinglet fluttered among the dense pine branches searching for insects.
examples.zh: 一只娇小的金冠戴菊鸟在茂密的松树枝间穿梭寻找昆虫。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kinglet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [动]王蛇(美国南部所产的一种大蛇)
lemmas.def_en: any of numerous nonvenomous North American constrictors; feed on other snakes and small mammals

examples.en: The nonvenomous kingsnake is known to hunt and eat even dangerous rattlesnakes.
examples.zh: 无毒的王蛇以捕食甚至危险的响尾蛇而闻名。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kingsnake 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any structure that makes progress difficult

examples.en: The hikers shed all unnecessary impedimenta to move more quickly up the steep mountain.
examples.zh: 徒步旅行者丢弃了所有不必要的累赘，以便更快地登上陡峭的山峰。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 impedimenta 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 人口普查, 五年时间
lemmas.def_en: a period of five years

examples.en: Nearly a lustrum had passed since the two old friends last saw each other.
examples.zh: 自这两位老友上次见面以来，差不多已经过去了五年时光。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lustrum 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 墨污, 污斑[点], 重叠印刷
lemmas.def_en: a printed impression that is blurred or doubled
