examples.en: The rare misprinted stamp had a distinct mackle caused by a moving printing plate.
examples.zh: 这枚罕见的错版邮票由于印版移动而带有明显的重影墨污。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mackle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [单复同]n.[烹](中间塞乳酪的)番茄沙司烙通心粉
lemmas.def_en: large pasta tubes stuffed with chopped meat or mild cheese and baked in tomato sauce

examples.en: Grandmother baked a bubbling dish of cheese-stuffed manicotti covered in rich tomato sauce.
examples.zh: 祖母烤了一盘热气腾腾的奶酪馅通心粉，上面淋着浓郁的番茄沙司。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 manicotti 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an ear of corn

examples.en: Local farmers harvested the sweet mealie crops before the heavy rainy season arrived.
examples.zh: 当地农民赶在大雨季来临之前收获了甜玉米作物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mealie 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an abnormal enlargement of the colon; can be congenital (as in Hirschsprung's disease) or acquired (as when children refuse to defecate)

examples.en: The veterinarian diagnosed the sick cat with toxic megacolon after reviewing the X-rays.
examples.zh: 兽医在查看X光片后诊断这只病猫患有中毒性巨结肠。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 megacolon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 屹立之史前时期纪念巨碑,竖石纪念碑
lemmas.def_en: a tall upright megalith; found primarily in England and northern France

examples.en: An ancient stone menhir stood silently on the windswept moor under the gray sky.
examples.zh: 一座古老的竖石纪念碑在狂风肆虐的荒原上静默耸立。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 menhir 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the dried fibrous part of the fruit of a plant of the genus Luffa; used as a washing sponge or strainer

examples.en: She grows dried luffa in her garden to use as natural exfoliating sponges.
examples.zh: 她在花园里种植干丝瓜，用来当做天然去角质海绵。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 luffa 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (British informal) stark naked

examples.en: He stripped starkers and took a refreshing midnight swim in the cold lake.
examples.zh: 他脱得精光，在冰冷的湖水里畅快地游了个午夜泳。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 starkers 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the interrelation of conscious and unconscious processes and emotions that determine personality and motivation

examples.en: The therapist explored the psychodynamics behind her anxiety and persistent childhood fears.
examples.zh: 治疗师探究了她焦虑和持续童年恐惧背后的精神动力学。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 psychodynamics 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 用红土做记号, 涂红土
lemmas.def_en: twist or braid together, interlace

examples.en: The shepherd used colored clay to ruddle the rams before releasing them onto pastures.
examples.zh: 牧羊人把公羊涂上红土做标记，然后将它们放到牧场上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ruddle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the cardinal number that is the sum of five and one

examples.en: Young Sise walked proudly across the stage to receive his high school graduation diploma.
examples.zh: 年轻的赛斯自豪地走过舞台，领取他的高中毕业证书。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sise 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: delivering an address to a public audience

examples.en: The nervous politician practiced his speechmaking for hours in front of a mirror.
examples.zh: 这位紧张的政客在镜子前练习了数小时的公开演讲。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 speechmaking 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 呼吸孔, 气孔, 喷水孔
lemmas.def_en: a breathing orifice

examples.en: Water exited through the shark's spiracle as it rested near the sandy seabed.
examples.zh: 鲨鱼在沙质海床附近休息时，水从它的喷水孔排出。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 spiracle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 亚锡的, 含二价锡的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or containing tin

examples.en: Many commercial toothpastes contain stannous fluoride to help protect teeth from decay.
examples.zh: 许多市售牙膏含有氟化亚锡，有助于防止牙齿蛀蚀。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stannous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: bottom-dwelling fish having scaleless slimy skin and a broad thick head with a wide mouth

examples.en: The camouflaged toadfish blended perfectly into the rocky bottom, waiting for unwary prey.
examples.zh: 伪装起来的蟾鱼与岩石底部完全融为一体，等待毫无防备的猎物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 toadfish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: send something via a facsimile machine

examples.en: Please telefax the signed contract to our corporate office as soon as possible.
examples.zh: 请尽快将签署好的合同远程传真至我们的公司总部。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 telefax 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a unit of information equal to 1000 gigabits or 10^12 (1,000,000,000,000) bits

examples.en: The new fiber-optic cable can transmit several terabits of data per second.
examples.zh: 这种新型光缆每秒能够传输数太比特的数据。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 terabit 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [医]甲状腺毒症, 甲状腺功能亢进
lemmas.def_en: an overactive thyroid gland; pathologically excessive production of thyroid hormones or the condition resulting from excessive production of thyroid hormones

examples.en: Rapid weight loss and trembling hands were primary symptoms of her severe thyrotoxicosis.
examples.zh: 体重迅速减轻和双手颤抖是她严重甲状腺毒症的主要症状。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 thyrotoxicosis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (ethics) a doctrine holding that moral statements prescribe appropriate attitudes and behavior

examples.en: Linguistic prescriptivism often ignores how real people actually communicate every day.
examples.zh: 语言规定主义往往忽略了人们在日常生活中真实的交流方式。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 prescriptivism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the side or slope of a mountain

examples.en: Dense forests cover the western versant of the mountain range.
examples.zh: 茂密的森林覆盖着该山脉的西侧斜坡。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 versant 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 青年贵族, 青年绅士, (非正式)年轻人, 小孩, 小伙子
lemmas.def_en: a young person (especially a young man or boy)

examples.en: The energetic younker spent all afternoon kicking a ball in the yard.
examples.zh: 那个精力充沛的小年轻整个下午都在院子里踢球。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 younker 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: infectious disease of birds

examples.en: He contracted psittacosis after cleaning out the contaminated bird cage.
examples.zh: 他在清理被污染的鸟笼后感染了鹦鹉热。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 psittacosis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a creation created or assembled by needle and thread

examples.en: My grandmother taught me traditional needlecraft using colorful silk threads.
examples.zh: 我祖母用五彩丝线教我传统的刺绣针线活。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 needlecraft 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 高级教士之职, 主教
lemmas.def_en: prelates collectively

examples.en: Critics argued that the wealthy prelacy was out of touch with ordinary parishioners.
examples.zh: 批评者认为富有的主教阶层脱离了普通教区居民。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 prelacy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (尤指惩罚)应得的, 适宜的
lemmas.def_en: fitting or appropriate and deserved; used especially of punishment

examples.en: The corrupt official finally received condign punishment for his serious crimes.
examples.zh: 那名腐败官员因其严重罪行终于受到了应得的惩罚。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 condign 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a paving stone forming part of a curb

examples.en: She tripped on a loose curbstone while crossing the busy downtown street.
examples.zh: 她在穿过繁忙的市中心街道时不小心被松动的路缘石绊倒了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 curbstone 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 放线菌块, 硫黄色颗粒, 脉络膜小疣
lemmas.def_en: (plural) an eye disease resulting from small accumulations of hyaline bodies underneath the retina

examples.en: The eye examination revealed small drusen beneath the patient's retina.
examples.zh: 眼科检查显示患者视网膜下方有微小的脉络膜小疣。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 drusen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a graphical record of electric currents associated with muscle contractions

examples.en: The doctor ordered an electromyogram to evaluate the patient's nerve function.
examples.zh: 医生安排了肌电图检查以评估患者的神经功能。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 electromyogram 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a collection of pus in a body cavity (especially in the lung cavity)

examples.en: Antibiotics alone were not enough to clear the severe pleural empyema.
examples.zh: 单靠抗生素不足以清除严重的胸膜积脓症。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 empyema 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a large group of bacteria having rigid cell walls; motile types have flagella

examples.en: Most common soil microorganisms fall into the scientific category of eubacteria.
examples.zh: 大多数常见的土壤微生物都属于真细菌这一科学范畴。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 eubacteria 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [体]法特莱克训练法(一种加速跑与慢跑交替进行的中长跑训练方法)
lemmas.def_en: a method of athletic training (especially for runners) in which strenuous effort and normal effort alternate in a continuous exercise

examples.en: The track coach incorporated fartlek training to improve the runners' stamina.
examples.zh: 田径教练加入了法特莱克训练法来提高跑步选手的耐力。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fartlek 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a set of gears

examples.en: The mechanic replaced the worn gearset to restore smooth transmission.
examples.zh: 技工更换了磨损的齿轮组，以恢复平稳的动力传输。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gearset 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (多指熟的)羊腿, 羊腿形袖子
lemmas.def_en: lamb leg suitable for roasting

examples.en: We roasted a seasoned gigot of lamb for our Sunday family dinner.
examples.zh: 我们烤了一只调味羊腿作为周日的家庭晚餐。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gigot 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: sweet green or greenish-yellow variety of plum

examples.en: She picked a ripe greengage straight from the tree and ate it.
examples.zh: 她直接从树上摘下一颗成熟的青梅李吃了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 greengage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: agglutination of red blood cells

examples.en: The lab test uses viral hemagglutination to determine blood compatibility.
examples.zh: 该实验室测试利用病毒性血凝反应来确定血液相容性。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hemagglutination 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 臀骨, 无名骨, 髋骨
lemmas.def_en: large flaring bone forming one half of the pelvis; made up of the ilium and ischium and pubis

examples.en: The elderly woman fractured her left hipbone during an accidental fall.
examples.zh: 这位老妇人在一次意外跌倒中折断了左髋骨。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hipbone 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: having or resembling hoofs

examples.en: The muddy trail was marked with deep tracks from hooved animals.
examples.zh: 泥泞的小路上留下了有蹄动物留下的深深印迹。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hooved 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a primer that provides instruction in the rudiments or basic skills of a branch of knowledge

examples.en: Colonial schoolchildren learned their first alphabet letters from a wooden hornbook.
examples.zh: 殖民时期的学童是从木制角贴书上学习最初的字母表的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hornbook 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: disorder in which serous fluid accumulates in a body sac (especially in the scrotum)

examples.en: The surgeon performed a routine procedure to drain the uncomfortable hydrocele.
examples.zh: 外科医生进行了常规手术以引流令人不适的阴囊积水。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hydrocele 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: mostly widely cultivated species of everlasting flowers having usually purple flowers; southern Europe to Iran; naturalized elsewhere

examples.en: She placed a delicate wreath of immortelle on the stone mantle.
examples.zh: 她在石制壁炉架上摆放了一个精致的不凋花花环。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 immortelle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 土生的动植物, 土著
lemmas.def_en: an indigenous person who was born in a particular place

examples.en: Researchers consulted a local indigene to learn about medicinal forest plants.
examples.zh: 研究人员咨询了当地土著，以了解森林药用植物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 indigene 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 入鞘, 凹入, 反折, 反折处, 凹入部分, 肠套叠
lemmas.def_en: the condition of being folded inward or sheathed

examples.en: The cellular invagination process is crucial during the early stages of development.
examples.zh: 细胞内陷过程在发育的早期阶段至关重要。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 invagination 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a monastery for lamas

examples.en: The ancient lamasery stands peacefully atop the remote windswept mountain.
examples.zh: 这座古老的喇嘛庙宁静地矗立在偏远、迎风的山顶上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lamasery 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 密特拉神的,崇拜密特拉神的, 密特拉教的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to Mithraism or its god

examples.en: Archaeologists uncovered a remarkably preserved Mithraic temple beneath the bustling modern city streets.
examples.zh: 考古学家在繁华的现代城市街道下发掘出一座保存完好的密特拉神庙。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mithraic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a very young lamb

examples.en: The mother tenderly tucked her little lambkin into bed with a soft lullaby.
examples.zh: 母亲唱着轻柔的摇篮曲，温柔地把她的小宝贝塞进被窝。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lambkin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a slender endoscope inserted through an incision in the abdominal wall in order to examine the abdominal organs or to perform minor surgery

examples.en: The surgeon inserted the laparoscope through a tiny incision to examine the internal organs.
examples.zh: 外科医生通过一个微小的切口插入腹腔镜来检查内部器官。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 laparoscope 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a minimal unit (as a word or stem) in the lexicon of a language; `go' and `went' and `gone' and `going' are all members of the English lexeme `go'

examples.en: In linguistics, the words 'walks', 'walking', and 'walked' all represent the same lexeme.
examples.zh: 在语言学中，“walks”、“walking”和“walked”都代表同一个词位。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lexeme 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the period between successive new moons (29.531 days)

examples.en: Ancient calendars often relied on the natural cycle of a lunation to measure time.
examples.zh: 古代历法通常依靠一个朔望月的自然周期来计量时间。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lunation 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a trivalent metallic element of the rare earth group; usually occurs in association with yttrium

examples.en: Lutetium is one of the rarest and most expensive elements of the lanthanide series.
examples.zh: 镥是镧系元素中最稀有且最昂贵的元素之一。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lutetium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 马库姆巴(巴西黑人的一种宗教仪式)
lemmas.def_en: (Brazil) followers of a religious cult of African origin

examples.en: They heard the steady rhythm of drums echoing during the traditional Macumba ceremony.
examples.zh: 在传统的马库姆巴仪式中，他们听到了持续回荡的鼓点声。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 macumba 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （外资公司在墨西哥开办的、产品回销本国的）组装工厂
lemmas.def_en: an assembly plant in Mexico (near the United States border); parts are shipped into Mexico and the finished product is shipped back across the border

examples.en: Thousands of local workers cross the border daily to work in the electronics maquiladora.
examples.zh: 成千上万的当地工人每天跨越边境去这家电子组装工厂上班。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 maquiladora 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可买卖的, 有销路的
lemmas.def_en: fit to be offered for sale

examples.en: The farmer ensured that only merchantable fruit of the highest quality reached the market.
examples.zh: 农场主确保只有最高品质、有销路的水果才能进入市场。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 merchantable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the middle germ layer that develops into muscle and bone and cartilage and blood and connective tissue

examples.en: During early embryonic development, the mesoblast gives rise to bones and muscular tissues.
examples.zh: 在早期胚胎发育过程中，中胚层会分化出发育为骨骼和肌肉组织。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mesoblast 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a plant of the genus Portulaca having pink or red or purple or white ephemeral flowers

examples.en: Bright portulaca flowers bloomed profusely along the sun-drenched edge of the garden path.
examples.zh: 鲜艳的马齿苋花在阳光普照的花园小径旁繁茂地盛开。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 portulaca 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a plant of the genus Corydalis with beautiful compound foliage and spurred tubular flowers

examples.en: The herbalist carefully harvested the roots of the corydalis to make traditional pain medicine.
examples.zh: 草药医生小心地采挖紫堇属植物的根来制作传统的止痛药。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 corydalis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any thick, viscous matter

examples.en: A thick layer of greasy guck had accumulated inside the old kitchen drainpipe.
examples.zh: 旧厨房的排水管里积聚了一层厚厚的油腻粘稠物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 guck 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the dishonesty of a charlatan

examples.en: The medical board revoked his license to protect vulnerable patients from dangerous charlatanism.
examples.zh: 医疗委员会吊销了他的执照，以保护弱势患者免受危险江湖医术的伤害。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 charlatanism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a blood disorder characterized by an increased concentration of hydrogen ions in the blood (which falls below 7 on the pH scale)

examples.en: Severe acidemia can rapidly cause organ failure if the blood pH is not restored.
examples.zh: 如果血液pH值未恢复正常，严重的酸血症会迅速导致器官衰竭。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 acidemia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: man's hat with a low, flat crown and a snap brim

examples.en: He packed a cold porkpie and a bottle of cider for the countryside picnic.
examples.zh: 他带了一个冷猪肉饼和一瓶苹果酒去乡村野餐。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 porkpie 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of several submerged or floating freshwater perennial aquatic weeds belonging to the family Potamogetonaceae

examples.en: Dense green pondweed drifted near the surface, providing shelter for the tiny fish.
examples.zh: 茂密的绿色水草在水面附近漂浮，为小鱼提供了庇护所。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pondweed 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: forming derivative or compound words by putting together constituents each of which expresses a single definite meaning

examples.en: Many indigenous languages of the Americas are polysynthetic, combining multiple morphemes into words.
examples.zh: 许多美洲原住民语言是多词素综合语，将多个语素组合成单个词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 polysynthetic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: rank in a military organization

examples.en: His recent promotion to the next military paygrade came with significantly higher responsibilities.
examples.zh: 他最近晋升到下一个军队薪饷等级，同时也承担了更大的责任。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 paygrade 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 行乞, 乞讨, 贩卖
lemmas.def_en: ask for and get free; be a parasite

examples.en: The broke student tried to cadge a free ride home from his roommate.
examples.zh: 身无分文的学生试图向室友讨要一次免费搭车回家的机会。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cadge 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a public place in ancient Greece or Rome devoted to the training of wrestlers and other athletes

examples.en: Young athletes in ancient Greece gathered at the palaestra to practice wrestling and boxing.
examples.zh: 古希腊的年轻运动员聚集在角力场练习摔跤和拳击。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 palaestra 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 金蝶兰属植物(产于热带美洲,包括蝴蝶兰、虎兰等)
lemmas.def_en: any orchid of the genus Oncidium: characterized by slender branching sprays of small yellow and brown flowers; often grown as houseplants

examples.en: Her collection included a delicate yellow oncidium that was famous for its dancing blossoms.
examples.zh: 她的收藏中包括一株娇美的黄色金蝶兰，以其舞姿般的花朵闻名。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 oncidium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 无价值的, 无用的, 无效的, 琐碎的
lemmas.def_en: of no real value

examples.en: The sudden change in policy rendered all our previous preparation completely nugatory.
examples.zh: 政策的突然改变使我们之前的所有准备工作完全付诸东流。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nugatory 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: terrestrial worm that burrows into and helps aerate soil; often surfaces when the ground is cool or wet; used as bait by anglers

examples.en: The worried parents locked the doors to keep the young nightwalker safe inside.
examples.zh: 焦急的父母锁上了门，以确保这个年幼的梦游者的室内安全。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nightwalker 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: garments designed to be worn in bed

examples.en: She changed into warm nightclothes and curled up on the couch with a book.
examples.zh: 她换上暖和的睡衣，卷缩在沙发上看书。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nightclothes 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: put (things or places) in order

examples.en: She took a few minutes to neaten her desk before leaving the office.
examples.zh: 离开办公室前，她花了几分钟把书桌整理整齐。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 neaten 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an actor who communicates entirely by gesture and facial expression

examples.en: The festival featured a traditional mummer performing silent skits for the crowd.
examples.zh: 节日里，一位传统的哑剧演员为人群表演了无声短剧。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mummer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: tropical American shrub bearing edible acid red fruit resembling cherries

examples.en: Rich in vitamin C, acerola is often used as a natural health supplement.
examples.zh: 针叶樱桃富含维生素C，常被用作天然保健补充剂。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 acerola 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of several erect or climbing woody plants of the genus Mucuna; widespread in tropics of both hemispheres

examples.en: Farmers planted mucuna as a cover crop to enrich the depleted soil.
examples.zh: 农民种植黎豆作为覆盖作物，以改善贫瘠的土壤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mucuna 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 含糊其词, 马虎处理, 讨价还价, 敷衍了事
lemmas.def_en: be deliberately ambiguous or unclear in order to mislead or withhold information

examples.en: A trustworthy leader should state facts clearly and never palter with the truth.
examples.zh: 值得信赖的领导者应当清晰说明事实，绝不含糊其词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 palter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a small parachute or articulated flap to reduce the speed of an aircraft

examples.en: The pilot deployed the airbrake to slow the jet down during its final approach.
examples.zh: 飞行员在最后进场时打开减速板以降低喷气机的速度。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 airbrake 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: minute sedentary marine invertebrate having a saclike body with siphons through which water enters and leaves

examples.en: The marine biologist discovered a colorful ascidian clinging firmly to the reef.
examples.zh: 海洋生物学家在珊瑚礁上发现了一只紧紧附着的彩色海鞘。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ascidian 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 出租车司机, 出租马车的车夫
lemmas.def_en: someone who drives a taxi for a living

examples.en: The tired cabman navigated his horse through the foggy streets of Victorian London.
examples.zh: 疲惫的车夫驾着马车穿行在维多利亚时代伦敦雾气弥漫的街道上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cabman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small sweet triangular nut of any of various beech trees

examples.en: The squirrel quickly buried a fallen beechnut beneath the crisp autumn leaves.
examples.zh: 松鼠迅速将一颗掉落的山毛榉果实埋在清脆的秋叶下。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 beechnut 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a boating song sung by Venetian gondoliers

examples.en: The pianist played a gentle barcarolle that evoked the swaying waters of Venice.
examples.zh: 钢琴家弹奏了一首温柔的船歌，让人联想到威尼斯荡漾的碧波。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 barcarolle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: self-induced fluorescence

examples.en: The researcher adjusted the microscope filters to reduce strong autofluorescence in the tissue.
examples.zh: 研究人员调整了显微镜滤光片，以减少组织中强烈的自发荧光。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 autofluorescence 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 天文动力学, 宇宙飞行力学
lemmas.def_en: the branch of astronomy that studies the motion of natural and artificial bodies in space

examples.en: She studied astrodynamics to help plot optimal trajectories for deep-space exploration probes.
examples.zh: 她研究航天动力学，以帮助为深空探测器规划最佳飞行轨迹。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 astrodynamics 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a person with dark skin who comes from Africa (or whose ancestors came from Africa)

examples.en: An antique blackamoor statue stood prominently in the corner of the grand hallway.
examples.zh: 一座古董黑人雕像醒目地立在宽敞门厅的角落里。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 blackamoor 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a pathology or abnormality of a joint

examples.en: The elderly patient sought specialized medical treatment for severe chronic arthropathy in his knees.
examples.zh: 这位老年患者因双膝严重的慢性关节病而寻求专业医疗救治。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 arthropathy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an organ in its earliest stage of development; the foundation for subsequent development

examples.en: During early embryonic development, the cellular anlage begins to differentiate into specialized tissues.
examples.zh: 在早期胚胎发育过程中，细胞原基开始分化为专门的组织。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 anlage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 喜爱读书的人，爱好书的人
lemmas.def_en: someone who loves (and usually collects) books

examples.en: As a passionate booklover, he spent his entire Saturday browsing local independent bookstores.
examples.zh: 作为一名狂热的书迷，他周六一整天都在逛当地的独立书店。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 booklover 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: furnishing added support

examples.en: The legal contract included the main house and all lands appurtenant to the property.
examples.zh: 该法律合同包括主房屋以及属于该地产的所有附属土地。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 appurtenant 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: divide into two or more branches so as to form a fork

examples.en: The quiet woodland path began to furcate into two narrower trails ahead.
examples.zh: 前方静谧的林间小路开始分叉成两条更窄的小径。

lemmas.def_en: the place where something divides into branches

family_guide.root_logic: 以 furcate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of various plants of the genus Scabiosa

examples.en: The doctor examined the scabious lesions on the patient's skin before prescribing ointment.
examples.zh: 医生在开药膏之前仔细检查了患者皮肤上的疥疮性皮损。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scabious 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 好色者, 感觉论者, 快乐论者
lemmas.def_en: a person who enjoys sensuality

examples.en: A shameless sensualist, he spent his immense fortune entirely on fine wine and luxury.
examples.zh: 作为一个放纵的享乐主义者，他将巨额财富全挥霍在美酒与奢华生活上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sensualist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a Hindu religious mendicant

examples.en: Having renounced worldly possessions, the peaceful sanyasi wandered quietly from village to village.
examples.zh: 这位放弃了尘世财富的平和苦修僧，静静地从一个村庄流浪到另一个村庄。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sanyasi 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 雪犁, 扫雪机, 犁雪机
lemmas.def_en: a vehicle used to push snow from roads

examples.en: A massive snowplough cleared the drifted snow from the highway before morning rush hour.
examples.zh: 早高峰前，一辆大型扫雪机清除了公路上堆积的积雪。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 snowplough 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: singing using solfa syllables to denote the notes of the scale of C major

examples.en: The music teacher used solfege to help the young choir students master pitch.
examples.zh: 音乐老师用唱名法帮助年轻的合唱团学生掌握音准。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 solfege 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: infection that occurs while you are being treated for another infection

examples.en: Prolonged use of broad-spectrum antibiotics increased the patient's risk of a bacterial superinfection.
examples.zh: 长期使用广谱抗生素增加了患者发生细菌双重感染的风险。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 superinfection 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 猪的, 猪一般的, 贪婪的
lemmas.def_en: ill-mannered and coarse and contemptible in behavior or appearance

examples.en: His swinish behavior at the dinner table disgusted everyone present in the room.
examples.zh: 他在餐桌上粗鄙贪婪的举止让房间里的每个人都感到厌恶。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 swinish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of various plants of the genus Sesbania having pinnate leaves and large showy pea-like flowers

examples.en: Farmers often plant sesbania to enrich the poor soil with vital nitrogen.
examples.zh: 农民经常种植田菁，为贫瘠的土壤补充关键的氮素。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sesbania 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: primitive marine animal having a saclike unsegmented body and a urochord that is conspicuous in the larva

examples.en: The marine biologist carefully collected a translucent tunicate from the coral reef.
examples.zh: 海洋生物学家小心翼翼地从珊瑚礁中采集了一只半透明的被囊动物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tunicate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a stabilizer that is part of the vertical tail structure of an airplane

examples.en: The sharp tailfin of the shark briefly broke the surface of the water.
examples.zh: 鲨鱼锋利的尾鳍短暂地破水而出。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tailfin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: thought to derive from meteorites

examples.en: He found a rare black tektite formed during an ancient meteorite impact.
examples.zh: 他找到了一块在古代陨石撞击过程中形成的罕见黑色玻璃陨石。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tektite 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a scolding nagging bad-tempered woman

examples.en: In the classic play, the main character is married to a nagging termagant.
examples.zh: 在这部经典戏剧中，主角娶了一个爱唠叨的悍妇。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 termagant 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 敕令, 圣旨, 谕旨
lemmas.def_en: an edict of the Russian tsar

examples.en: The citizens were forced to obey the sudden ukase issued by the emperor.
examples.zh: 市民们被迫服从皇帝突然颁布的法令。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ukase 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (medicine) puncture of a vein through the skin in order to withdraw blood for analysis or to start an intravenous drip or to inject medication or a radiopaque dye

examples.en: The experienced nurse performed a smooth venipuncture with minimal discomfort to the patient.
examples.zh: 经验丰富的护士熟练地进行了静脉穿刺，患者几乎没有感到不适。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 venipuncture 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 代理执政者, 代理人
lemmas.def_en: someone appointed by a ruler as an administrative deputy

examples.en: He governed the distant province as the direct vicegerent of the monarch.
examples.zh: 他作为君主的直接全权代表统治着这个遥远的省份。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vicegerent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an ambitious and aspiring young person

examples.en: The studio was packed with every rock star wannabee from across the city.
examples.zh: 演播室里挤满了来自全城各个想要成为摇滚明星的人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wannabee 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of numerous very agile and alert New World lizards

examples.en: A small whiptail darted across the hot desert sand to catch a fly.
examples.zh: 一只小鞭尾蜥飞快地穿过炽热的沙漠沙地去抓苍蝇。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 whiptail 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a worker who installs and repairs electric wiring

examples.en: The certified wireman quickly resolved the complex electrical issues in the office building.
examples.zh: 持证电工迅速解决了办公楼内复杂的电气故障。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wireman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a French verse form of 10 or 13 lines running on two rhymes; the opening phrase is repeated as the refrain of the second and third stanzas

examples.en: The young poet recited a traditional rondel to close the evening literary reading.
examples.zh: 年轻诗人朗诵了一首传统的小回旋诗，结束了当晚的文学朗读会。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rondel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 萨克布号, 三角竖琴
lemmas.def_en: a medieval musical instrument resembling a trombone

examples.en: The early music ensemble featured a vintage sackbut alongside several wooden recorders.
examples.zh: 这支早期音乐乐团演奏时，复古萨克布号与几支木制竖笛相伴。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sackbut 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 用槽口接合, 嵌接；由槽口接合
lemmas.def_en: join with a rabbet joint

examples.en: You need to rabbet the edge of the board so the glass fits neatly.
examples.zh: 你需要在木板边缘开槽，以便让玻璃能严丝合缝地嵌进去。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rabbet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a handsaw for cutting with the grain of the wood

examples.en: He used a heavy ripsaw to cut the thick oak board along the grain.
examples.zh: 他用一把重型粗齿锯顺着纹理切割厚厚的橡木板。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ripsaw 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any doctrine emphasizing the importance of the context in solving problems or establishing the meaning of terms

examples.en: Architectural contextualism emphasizes designing new buildings that harmonize with their historical surroundings.
examples.zh: 建筑语境主义强调新建筑的设计应与周边的历史环境相协调。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 contextualism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 誊本保有权, 登录不动产保有权
lemmas.def_en: a medieval form of land tenure in England; a copyhold was a parcel of land granted to a peasant by the lord of the manor in return for agricultural services

examples.en: The peasant family finally converted their ancestral copyhold into full freehold land ownership.
examples.zh: 这户农民家庭最终将他们祖传的誊本保有地转为了完全自由保有地产权。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 copyhold 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: weedy annual grass often occurs in grainfields and other cultivated land; seeds sometimes considered poisonous

examples.en: Ancient farmers spent hours weeding toxic darnel out of their valuable wheat fields.
examples.zh: 古代农民花费数小时从珍贵的麦田中清除有毒的毒麦。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 darnel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 行动方针, 行动新方针
lemmas.def_en: a move or step or maneuver in political or diplomatic affairs

examples.en: The ambassador delivered a firm demarche to protest the neighboring country's aggressive actions.
examples.zh: 大使提出了严正的外交交涉，以抗议邻国的侵略行径。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 demarche 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: become immaterial; disappear

examples.en: The magician seemed to dematerialize right before our eyes, leaving behind only thin smoke.
examples.zh: 魔术师似乎就在我们眼前凭空消失了，只留下一缕轻烟。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dematerialize 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: absence or loss of pigmentation (or less than normal pigmentation) in the skin or hair

examples.en: The dermatologist noted severe depigmentation on the patient's hands, likely caused by vitiligo.
examples.zh: 皮肤科医生注意到患者手部有严重的色素脱失，可能是白癜风所致。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 depigmentation 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a milky fluid consisting of lymph and emulsified fats; formed in the small intestine during digestion of ingested fats

examples.en: During digestion, chyle moves from the small intestine into the lymphatic system.
examples.zh: 在消化过程中，乳糜从小肠流入淋巴系统。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chyle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: resembling a dog; especially in devotion

examples.en: The loyal assistant followed his mentor around with quiet, doglike devotion for years.
examples.zh: 多年来，这位忠诚的助手怀着如小狗般的忠心默默追随他的导师。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 doglike 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: duck-billed dinosaur from Canada found as a fossilized mummy with skin

examples.en: Fossils suggest that the herbivorous Edmontosaurus often traveled together in massive coastal herds.
examples.zh: 化石表明，草食性的埃德蒙顿龙常常结成庞大的群体在沿海地带迁徙。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 edmontosaurus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: application of a needle heated by an electric current to destroy tissue (as to remove warts)

examples.en: The surgeon used electrocautery to seal small bleeding vessels during the routine operation.
examples.zh: 在常规手术中，外科医生使用电烙术来封闭出血的小血管。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 electrocautery 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a Muslim or Hindu mendicant monk who is regarded as a holy man

examples.en: The wandering faqir sat quietly beneath the banyan tree, renouncing all worldly possessions.
examples.zh: 流浪的苦行僧静坐在菩提树下，舍弃了所有世俗财产。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 faqir 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: give new life or energy to

examples.en: A refreshing afternoon nap can revivify your tired mind after hours of hard study.
examples.zh: 经过数小时的刻苦学习后，小睡片刻能让你疲惫的大脑重新振作。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 revivify 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 开花, 花期, 全盛期
lemmas.def_en: the time and process of budding and unfolding of blossoms

examples.en: The garden reached its peak florescence in early June, dazzling visitors with colors.
examples.zh: 花园在六月初迎来了全盛花期，绚丽的色彩令游客目不暇接。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 florescence 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 喧闹的音乐, 喧闹声
lemmas.def_en: a noisy mock serenade (made by banging pans and kettles) to a newly married couple

examples.en: The wedding reception descended into a loud charivari of clattering pots and wild singing.
examples.zh: 婚宴变成了敲锅打盆、狂放歌唱的一片喧闹。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 charivari 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an adjustable stay from the foremast to the deck or bowsprit; controls the bending of the mast

examples.en: The sailor quickly tightened the forestay to prevent the mast from swaying dangerously.
examples.zh: 水手迅速收紧了前桅支索，以防桅杆发生危险的晃动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 forestay 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (紧急情况下将宇航员从沿轨道运行的航天器转移入救援运载工具的)密封球形救生器
lemmas.def_en: large and light ball; for play at the seaside

examples.en: Engineers tested a portable rescue beachball designed to transfer astronauts safely between spacecraft.
examples.zh: 工程师测试了一种便携式救援球舱，旨在将宇航员安全转移于航天器之间。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 beachball 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 尚不能肯定的, 偶然的
lemmas.def_en: dependent on chance

examples.en: He composed an aleatory piece of music that relied entirely on spontaneous chance.
examples.zh: 他创作了一首完全依赖偶发机遇的偶然音乐作品。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 aleatory 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the usual method of treating disease with remedies that produce effects differing from those produced by the disease itself

examples.en: Modern allopathy relies primarily on pharmaceutical drugs and surgery to treat acute illnesses.
examples.zh: 现代对抗疗法主要依靠药物和手术来治疗急性疾病。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 allopathy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a plant of the genus Aquilegia having irregular showy spurred flowers; north temperate regions especially mountains

examples.en: She planted delicate blue aquilegia along the shady path behind her country cottage.
examples.zh: 她在乡间小屋后阴凉的小径旁种下了娇嫩的蓝色耧斗菜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 aquilegia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or belonging to the hominid genus Australopithecus

examples.en: Researchers found an australopithecine jawbone that offered vital clues about early human evolution.
examples.zh: 研究人员发现了一块南方古猿的下颌骨，为人类早期进化提供了重要线索。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 australopithecine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a cotton knit fabric used for underwear

examples.en: He preferred wearing comfortable nightwear made of soft, breathable balbriggan during the winter.
examples.zh: 他冬天喜欢穿用柔软透气的巴尔布里根针织棉布制成的舒适睡衣。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 balbriggan 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 准男爵辈, 准男爵爵位, 准男爵名册
lemmas.def_en: the collective body of baronets

examples.en: The historian consulted an antique baronetage to trace the lineage of the noble family.
examples.zh: 历史学家查阅了一本古老的准男爵名册，以追溯该贵族家族的血统。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 baronetage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: consisting of or made of wood of the beech tree

examples.en: They sat peacefully beneath the beechen boughs, sheltered from the blazing summer sun.
examples.zh: 他们静静地坐在山毛榉树枝下，避开炎炎夏日的烈日。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 beechen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [植]草本植物主轴(包括茎与根),木本植物的茎基,茎
lemmas.def_en: persistent thickened stem of a herbaceous perennial plant

examples.en: The succulent develops a swollen caudex that stores water to survive prolonged droughts.
examples.zh: 这种多肉植物会长出膨大的茎基来储存水分，以度过长期干旱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 caudex 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: flat crusty-bottomed onion roll

examples.en: He grabbed a fresh onion bialy and a hot coffee before rushing to work.
examples.zh: 他在匆忙上班前买了一个新鲜的洋葱比亚利面包圈和一杯热咖啡。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bialy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: consisting of or made of wood of the birch tree

examples.en: The artisan carved a lovely set of bowls from fallen birken branches.
examples.zh: 手艺人用掉落的桦木树枝雕刻出了一套精美的木碗。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 birken 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 与现行社会秩序格格不入的, 不愿合作的
lemmas.def_en: obstreperous

examples.en: The manager disliked him because he had an argumentative and bolshy attitude.
examples.zh: 经理不喜欢他，因为他态度好辩且不合作。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bolshy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a person who polishes shoes and boots

examples.en: A young bootblack offered to shine my dusty shoes on the street.
examples.zh: 街上一名年轻的擦鞋匠主动提出帮我擦满是灰尘的鞋。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bootblack 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 波尔多酱；波尔多的圆柱式酒瓶；牛骨筒汁或波多汁
lemmas.def_en: brown sauce with beef marrow and red wine

examples.en: The chef drizzled a rich bordelaise sauce over the grilled beef tenderloin.
examples.zh: 厨师将浓郁的波尔多红酒酱淋在烤牛里脊上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bordelaise 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: covering for a person's feet

examples.en: You need sturdy and waterproof footgear before hiking up the rocky mountain.
examples.zh: 在攀登多石的山峰之前，你需要结实且防水的鞋履。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 footgear 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 无太平门的建筑物, 易失火的建筑物
lemmas.def_en: a building that would be hard to escape from if it were to catch fire

examples.en: Inspectors declared the crowded, old building an unsafe firetrap without emergency exits.
examples.zh: 检查员称这座没有安全出口的拥挤老楼是个危险的火灾隐患建筑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 firetrap 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: fish having a frog-like mouth with a lure on the snout

examples.en: The camouflaged frogfish waited motionless on the coral for unsuspecting prey.
examples.zh: 伪装起来的躄鱼在珊瑚上一动不动，等待毫无防备的猎物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 frogfish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 结束语, 演讲, 夸夸其谈
lemmas.def_en: a flowery and highly rhetorical oration

examples.en: The speaker summarized his main arguments during a passionate and powerful peroration.
examples.zh: 演讲者在激昂有力的结语中总结了他的主要观点。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 peroration 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the mucous membranes and skin

examples.en: The doctor examined the patient for mucocutaneous lesions around the lips.
examples.zh: 医生检查了患者嘴唇周围的黏膜皮肤病变。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mucocutaneous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 嬉戏的, 爱闹着玩的
lemmas.def_en: given to merry frolicking

examples.en: A frolicsome puppy chased autumn leaves across the sunny green lawn.
examples.zh: 一只顽皮嬉戏的小狗在洒满阳光的绿草坪上追逐秋叶。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 frolicsome 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an engine that provided medieval artillery used during sieges; a heavy war engine for hurling large stones and other missiles

examples.en: A small herd of onagers dashed swiftly across the dry Asian steppe.
examples.zh: 一小群中亚野驴在干燥的亚洲草原上飞速奔驰。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 onager 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 手淫, 自淫, 交媾中断
lemmas.def_en: manual stimulation of the genital organs (of yourself or another) for sexual pleasure

examples.en: Old medical texts often treated onanism as a severe moral and physical disorder.
examples.zh: 古老的医学文献常将手淫视为严重的道德与生理障碍。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 onanism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 展示全景的, 一览无遗的
lemmas.def_en: including everything visible in one view

examples.en: The observation deck offers a stunning panoptic view of the entire metropolis.
examples.zh: 观景台提供了整个大都市令人惊叹的全景视野。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 panoptic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 高级密织棉布, 细棉布
lemmas.def_en: a fine closely woven cotton fabric

examples.en: She bought crisp percale sheets to ensure a cool and comfortable sleep.
examples.zh: 她买了清爽的高密细棉布床单，以确保睡眠凉爽舒适。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 percale 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: common weedy European plant introduced into North America; often used as a potherb

examples.en: The farmer spent the morning pulling stubborn pigweed from his vegetable patch.
examples.zh: 农夫花了一上午时间从菜地里拔除顽固的野苋菜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pigweed 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: Mediterranean germander having small hairy leaves and reddish purple flowers; attractive to cats

examples.en: They drove through the quiet Dutch village of Marum during their holiday.
examples.zh: 他们在度假期间驾车穿过了安静的荷兰村庄马勒姆。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 marum 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (of mammals) walking on the whole sole of the foot (as rabbits, raccoons, bears, and humans do)

examples.en: Bears are plantigrade animals that walk on the entire soles of their feet.
examples.zh: 熊是跖行哺乳动物，走路时整个脚底着地。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 plantigrade 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 台球房, 赌注登记处
lemmas.def_en: a room with pool tables where pool is played

examples.en: The men gathered at the local poolroom to drink beer and play billiards.
examples.zh: 男人们聚在当地的台球室里喝啤酒、打台球。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 poolroom 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the Protozoa

examples.en: Contaminated drinking water can cause severe protozoal infections in the digestive tract.
examples.zh: 受污染的饮用水可引发消化道严重的单细胞原生动物感染。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 protozoal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the act of producing drawings on wood or leather by using heated tools or a fine flame

examples.en: She decorated the wooden keepsake box using an intricate technique of pyrography.
examples.zh: 她用复杂的烙画技术装饰了这个木制纪念品盒子。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pyrography 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 借人工方法或法术造雨
lemmas.def_en: activity intended to produce rain

examples.en: The government invested in modern rainmaking technology to relieve the severe regional drought.
examples.zh: 政府投资了现代人工降雨技术，以缓解该地区严重的干旱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rainmaking 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 被鼠咬成的洞, 鼠穴
lemmas.def_en: a hole (as in the wall of a building) made by rats

examples.en: I refused to stay in that dark, filthy rathole of a motel room.
examples.zh: 我拒绝住在汽车旅馆那个又黑又脏、像耗子洞一样的房间里。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rathole 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a woman sahib

examples.en: The domestic servants bowed respectfully as the memsahib entered the grand colonial drawing room.
examples.zh: 当太太走进宏伟的殖民地风格客厅时，仆人们恭敬地鞠躬。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 memsahib 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the act of nasalizing; the utterance of sounds modulated by the nasal resonators

examples.en: The teacher explained how vowel nasalization changes the pronunciation in French.
examples.zh: 老师解释了元音鼻音化是如何改变法语发音的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nasalization 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a woman who wears clothes to display fashions

examples.en: The male manakin performed an elaborate courtship dance in the tropical rainforest.
examples.zh: 雄性侏儒鸟在热带雨林中跳起了一段精心编排的求偶舞。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 manakin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: not capable of igniting and burning

examples.en: The warehouse walls were built using entirely incombustible materials to prevent disasters.
examples.zh: 仓库墙体完全采用不燃材料建造，以防止灾难发生。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 incombustible 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 实现；外接游戏手柄；我们还对
lemmas.def_en: a flat portable surface (usually rectangular) designed for board games

examples.en: She unfolded the colorful gameboard on the table to start playing with her friends.
examples.zh: 她在桌上展开色彩鲜艳的游戏盘，开始和朋友们玩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gameboard 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 能理解的, 可以懂的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being apprehended or understood

examples.en: The professor tried to make advanced quantum concepts graspable for the undergraduate students.
examples.zh: 教授努力让高深的量子概念对本科生来说通俗易懂。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 graspable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a long sturdy pin used by women to secure a hat to their hair

examples.en: The vintage hatpin was decorated with a small, beautifully crafted pearl at the top.
examples.zh: 这枚复古帽针的顶端装饰着一颗制作精美的小珍珠。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hatpin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: sausage containing ground liver

examples.en: He spread some spicy mustard and liverwurst onto a slice of fresh rye bread.
examples.zh: 他在一片新鲜黑麦面包上抹了些辣芥末和肝泥香肠。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 liverwurst 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a movement by American and English poets early in the 20th century in reaction to Victorian sentimentality; used common speech in free verse with clear concrete imagery

examples.en: The poet was heavily influenced by Imagism, preferring clear language and precise visual details.
examples.zh: 这位诗人深受意象派影响，偏爱清晰的语言和精准的视觉细节。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 imagism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: not able or intended to be moved

examples.en: Despite our persistent arguments, his decision on the project budget remained completely immoveable.
examples.zh: 尽管我们一再争辩，他在项目预算上的决定依然毫无动摇。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 immoveable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 照明, 点亮, 启发
lemmas.def_en: make lighter or brighter

examples.en: A single bright candle was enough to illume the entire small wooden cabin.
examples.zh: 一支明亮的蜡烛就足以照亮整个小木屋。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 illume 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 向内生长, 生进肉内的
lemmas.def_en: growing abnormally into the flesh

examples.en: Wearing shoes that are too tight can cause a painful ingrowing toenail to develop.
examples.zh: 穿过紧的鞋子可能会导致疼痛的嵌甲产生。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ingrowing 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 不通数学的；缺乏基本数学知识的
lemmas.def_en: lacking knowledge and understanding of mathematical concepts and methods

examples.en: Basic personal finance classes help prevent young adults from remaining financially innumerate and vulnerable.
examples.zh: 基础个人理财课程有助于防止年轻人对数字一窍不通并陷入财务困境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 innumerate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不安, 焦虑, 不安定
lemmas.def_en: feelings of anxiety that make you tense and irritable

examples.en: A sense of deep inquietude washed over her as the stormy night progressed.
examples.zh: 随着暴风雨之夜的推移，一股深深的不安笼罩了她。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inquietude 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: undergoing small rapid variations

examples.en: The shaky hand held the camera, producing a jittering and blurry video recording throughout.
examples.zh: 颤抖的手握着相机，导致拍出的整段视频都在抖动且模糊。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 jittering 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 垂片, 垂饰, 垂布
lemmas.def_en: a fleshy wrinkled and often brightly colored fold of skin hanging from the neck or throat of certain birds (chickens and turkeys) or lizards

examples.en: The lace lappet of her traditional bonnet fluttered gently in the cool evening breeze.
examples.zh: 她传统软帽上的蕾丝垂布在微凉的晚风中轻轻飘动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lappet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 排列, 行数, 按行数支付
lemmas.def_en: the number of lines in a piece of printed material

examples.en: Freelance journalists were often paid according to the total linage printed in the newspaper.
examples.zh: 自由记者通常根据在报纸上印出的总行数来获取稿酬。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 linage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 执拗, 顽固, 顽强, (疾病的)难治
lemmas.def_en: persistent determination

examples.en: His sheer pertinacity helped him overcome all technical obstacles and finish the novel on time.
examples.zh: 他那份顽强的毅力帮助他克服了所有技术障碍，按时完成了小说。

lemmas.def_zh: 坚持不放的, 执拗的, 顽固的, 顽强的, (疾病)难以治好的
lemmas.def_en: stubbornly unyielding; ; ; ; - T.S.Eliot

examples.en: dogged persistence
dour determination

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pertinacity 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 授予封地, 授予领地, 授予采邑, 转让
lemmas.def_en: put in possession of land in exchange for a pledge of service, in feudal society

examples.en: The medieval king decided to enfeoff his most loyal general with vast northern territories.
examples.zh: 中世纪的国王决定将广袤的北方领地封赏给他最忠诚的将军。

lemmas.def_en: under the feudal system, the deed by which a person was given land in exchange for a pledge of service

family_guide.root_logic: 以 enfeoff 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the monthly discharge of blood from the uterus of nonpregnant women from puberty to menopause; ; --Hippocrates; --Aristotle

examples.en: Severe abdominal cramps frequently accompanied the onset of her regular monthly catamenia.
examples.zh: 伴随着每月的月经来潮，她常常会出现严重的腹部绞痛。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to menstruation or the menses

examples.en: menstrual period

family_guide.root_logic: 以 catamenia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a small canal or duct as in some bones and parts of plants

examples.en: Nutrients travel smoothly to the bone cell through a microscopic channel called a canaliculus.
examples.zh: 营养物质通过被称为小管的微细通道顺利输送给骨细胞。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 canaliculus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a biochemical catalyst such as an enzyme

examples.en: The industrial process uses a natural biocatalyst to speed up the chemical reaction cleanly.
examples.zh: 该工业流程使用一种天然生物催化剂，以环保的方式加速化学反应。

lemmas.def_zh: 生物催化的（生物学术语）
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to biocatalysts

family_guide.root_logic: 以 biocatalyst 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: care for like a mother

examples.en: Parents who overprotect their children may prevent them from learning essential problem-solving skills.
examples.zh: 过分保护孩子的父母可能会阻碍他们学习基本的解决问题技能。

lemmas.def_en: excessive protection

family_guide.root_logic: 以 overprotect 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (alphanumeric 的复数) a. 字母数字的
lemmas.def_en: a character set that includes letters and digits and punctuation

examples.en: Your new online password must consist of both special symbols and standard alphanumerics.
examples.zh: 你的新网络密码必须由特殊符号和标准字母数字共同组成。

lemmas.def_en: of or pertaining to alphanumeric characters

family_guide.root_logic: 以 alphanumerics 为核心的派生词族。

etymology_logic: 口语中为 nanny 的昵称（奶奶/外婆）；烹饪中源自波斯语/印地语 nān（印度烤饼）。
confusion_note: 注：计算机领域大写的 NaN 为 Not a Number（非数字错误）的缩写，与本词无关。

lemmas.def_zh: 奶奶（小孩儿语）；印度, 巴基斯坦式的微微发酵的面包
lemmas.def_en: your grandmother

examples.en: We ordered fresh garlic nan to accompany the spicy chicken curry for dinner.
examples.zh: 我们点了新鲜的大蒜烤饼来搭配晚餐的香辣咖喱鸡。

lemmas.usage_note: 口语中指奶奶或外婆（等同于nanna）；科技语境中大写为 NaN（Not a Number），表示非数字计算错误。
